text.title: <Beschützen> (Du darfst diesen Charakter erschöpft ausspielen. Gegnerische Charaktere müssen beim Herausfordern deiner Charaktere zuerst deine Charaktere mit Beschützen wählen, wenn möglich.)
Chant du troupeau
text.description: Jouer ce personnage vous coûte 1 {I} de moins par carte Chanson dans votre défausse.

text.title: <Rempart> (Ce personnage peut entrer en jeu épuisé. Lorsqu'un adversaire défie l'un de vos personnages, il doit, si possible, choisir l'un de vos personnages avec Rempart.)
Canzone del Branco
text.description: Per ogni carta canzone nei tuoi scarti, paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare questo personaggio.

set5-014.name: Mirabel Madrigal
set5-014.rulesText: NOT WITHOUT MY FAMILY You can't play this character unless you have 5 or more characters in play.

text.title: NOT WITHOUT MY FAMILY
text.description: You can't play this character unless you have 5 or more characters in play.

text.title: Nicht ohne meine Familie
text.description: Du kannst diesen Charakter nicht ausspielen, außer du hast mindestens 5 Charaktere im Spiel.

text.title: Pas sans ma famille
text.description: Vous ne pouvez pas jouer ce personnage à moins d'avoir 5 personnages ou plus en jeu.

text.title: Non Senza la Mia Famiglia
text.description: Non puoi giocare questo personaggio a meno che tu non abbia in gioco 5 o più personaggi.

set5-015.name: Minnie Mouse
set5-015.rulesText:
Shift 4
PARADE ORDER When you play this character, if you used Shift to play her, you may search your deck for a character card and reveal that card to all players. Shuffle your deck and put that card on top of it.

text.title: PARADE ORDER
text.description: When you play this character, if you used Shift to play her, you may search your deck for a character card and reveal that card to all players. Shuffle your deck and put that card on top of it.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 4 (Du kannst 4 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Minnie-Maus-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Reihenfolge der Parade
text.description: Falls du <Gestaltwandel> benutzt hast, um diesen Charakter auszuspielen, darfst du dein Deck nach einer Charakterkarte durchsuchen und diese allen Mitspielenden zeigen. Mische danach dein Deck und lege die gewählte Karte als oberste Karte auf dein Deck.

text.title: <Alter> 4 (Vous pouvez payer 4 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Minnie.)
Cheffe de la fanfare
text.description: Si vous jouez ce personnage en utilisant sa capacité <Alter>, vous pouvez chercher une carte Personnage dans votre pioche et la révéler à tous les joueurs. Mélangez votre pioche puis placez la carte révélée sur le dessus.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 4 (Puoi pagare 4 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Minni.)
Ordine di Marcia
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, se hai usato <Trasformazione> per giocarlo, puoi cercare una carta personaggio nel tuo mazzo e rivelare quella carta a tutti i giocatori. Rimescola il tuo mazzo e metti quella carta in cima ad esso.

set5-016.name: Daisy Duck
set5-016.rulesText: BIG PRIZE Whenever this character quests, each opponent reveals the top card of their deck. If it's a character card, they may put it into their hand. Otherwise, they put it on the bottom of their deck.

text.title: BIG PRIZE
text.description: Whenever this character quests, each opponent reveals the top card of their deck. If it's a character card, they may put it into their hand. Otherwise, they put it on the bottom of their deck.

text.title: Großer Gewinn
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, decken alle gegnerischen Mitspielenden die oberste Karte ihres Decks auf. Falls sie eine Charakterkarte ist, dürfen sie diese auf ihre Hand nehmen. Falls nicht, legen sie diese unter ihr Deck.

text.title: Gros lot
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, chaque adversaire révèle la carte du dessus de sa pioche. S'il s'agit d'une carte Personnage, il peut la prendre en main. Sinon, il la place sous sa pioche.

text.title: Primo Premio
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, ogni avversario rivela la prima carta del suo mazzo. Se è una carta personaggio, l'avversario può aggiungerla alla sua mano. Altrimenti, la mette in fondo al suo mazzo.

set5-017.name: Fix-It Felix, Jr.
set5-017.rulesText: OH, MY LAND! When you play this character, if you have a location in play, draw a card.

text.title: OH, MY LAND!
text.description: When you play this character, if you have a location in play, draw a card.

text.title: Ach du meine Güte!
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst und mindestens einen Ort im Spiel hast, ziehe 1 Karte.

text.title: Nom d'un petit bonus!
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, si vous avez un lieu en jeu, piochez une carte.

text.title: Per Tutte le Land!
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, se hai in gioco un luogo, pesca una carta.

set5-019.name: Vanellope von Schweetz
set5-019.rulesText:
Shift 2
I HEREBY DECREE Whenever you play another Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: I HEREBY DECREE
text.description: Whenever you play another Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: <Shift> 2 (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Vanellope von Schweetz.)
I Hereby Decree
text.description: Whenever you play another Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: <Shift> 2 (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Vanellope von Schweetz.)
I Hereby Decree
text.description: Whenever you play another Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: <Shift> 2 (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Vanellope von Schweetz.)
I Hereby Decree
text.description: Whenever you play another Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

set5-020.name: Alan-a-Dale
set5-020.rulesText: FAN FAVORITE Whenever you play a song, gain 1 lore.

text.title: FAN FAVORITE
text.description: Whenever you play a song, gain 1 lore.

text.title: Fan-Liebling
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du ein Lied ausspielst, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: Favori de la foule
text.description: Chaque fois que vous jouez une chanson, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Beniamino dei Fan
text.description: Ogni volta che giochi una canzone, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set5-021.name: Wreck-It Ralph
set5-021.rulesText: I'VE GOT THE COOLEST FRIEND When you play this character, return a character card from your discard to your hand. If that card is a Princess character card, gain 2 lore.

text.title: I'VE GOT THE COOLEST FRIEND
text.description: When you play this character, return a character card from your discard to your hand. If that card is a Princess character card, gain 2 lore.

text.title: Ich habe die coolste Freundin
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, nimm 1 Charakterkarte aus deinem Ablagestapel zurück auf deine Hand. Falls jene Karte eine Prinzessin-Charakterkarte ist, sammelst du 2 Legenden.

text.title: La meilleure amie du monde
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, renvoyez une carte Personnage de votre défausse dans votre main. S'il s'agit d'un personnage Princesse, gagnez 2 éclats de Lore.

text.title: Ho l'Amica più Straordinaria
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, riprendi in mano una carta personaggio dai tuoi scarti. Se quella carta è una carta personaggio Principessa, ottieni 2 leggenda.

set5-022.name: Maid Marian
set5-022.rulesText: IF IT PLEASES THE LADY When you play this character, chosen opposing character gets -5 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: IF IT PLEASES THE LADY
text.description: When you play this character, chosen opposing character gets -5 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Wenn die Lady es will
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, erhält ein gegnerischer Charakter deiner Wahl bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges -5 {S}.

text.title: Si Madame veut bien...
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, choisissez un personnage adverse qui subit -5 {S} jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Se la Lady è d'Accordo
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, un personaggio avversario a tua scelta riceve -5 {S} fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

set5-023.name: Sven
set5-023.rulesText: REINDEER GAMES When you play this character, you may ready chosen character. They can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.

text.title: REINDEER GAMES
text.description: When you play this character, you may ready chosen character. They can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.

text.title: Rentier Spiele
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, darfst du einen Charakter deiner Wahl bereit machen. Er kann in diesem Zug nicht mehr erkunden oder herausfordern.

text.title: Jeux de rennes
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et le redresser. Il ne peut ni partir à l'aventure ni défier pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Giochi da Renne
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, puoi preparare un personaggio a tua scelta. Non può andare all'avventura o sfidare per il resto di questo turno.

set5-024.name: Minnie Mouse
set5-024.rulesText: PATCH THEM UP Whenever this character quests, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

text.title: PATCH THEM UP
text.description: Whenever this character quests, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

text.title: Flickt sie wieder zusammen
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du bis zu 2 Schaden von einem Charakter deiner Wahl entfernen.

text.title: Un petit remède!
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et lui retirer jusqu'à 2 dommages.

text.title: Rattopparli
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi rimuovere fino a 2 danni da un personaggio a tua scelta.

set5-035.name: Maleficent
set5-035.rulesText:
Shift 6
LISTEN WELL, ALL OF YOU When you play this character, for each of your characters named Maleficent in play, return a chosen opposing character, item, or location with cost 3 or less to their player's hand.

text.title: LISTEN WELL, ALL OF YOU
text.description: When you play this character, for each of your characters named Maleficent in play, return a chosen opposing character, item, or location with cost 3 or less to their player's hand.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 6 (Du kannst 6 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Malefiz-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Alle, die ihr hier seid, hört mich an.
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, schicke, für jeden deiner Malefiz-Charaktere im Spiel, je einen gegnerischen Charakter, Gegenstand oder Ort deiner Wahl, der 3 oder weniger kostet, auf die zugehörige Hand zurück.

text.title: <Alter> 6 (Vous pouvez payer 6 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Maléfique.)
Ouvrez bien vos oreilles
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, pour chacun de vos personnages Maléfique en jeu, choisissez un personnage, objet ou lieu adverse avec un coût de 3 ou moins et renvoyez-le dans la main de son propriétaire.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 6 (Puoi pagare 6 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Malefica.)
Ascoltate tutti quanti
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, per ogni tuo personaggio in gioco chiamato Malefica, fai riprendere in mano al suo giocatore un personaggio, un oggetto o un luogo avversario a tua scelta con costo 3 o inferiore.

set5-036.name: The Nokk
set5-036.rulesText: TURNING TIDES When you play this character, you may move up to 2 damage counters from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: TURNING TIDES
text.description: When you play this character, you may move up to 2 damage counters from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Gezeitenwechsel
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, darfst du bis zu 2 Schadensmarker von einem Charakter deiner Wahl zu einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl verschieben.

text.title: Marées changeantes
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et déplacer jusqu'à 2 de ses dommages sur un personnage adverse de votre choix.

text.title: Invertire la Marea
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, puoi spostare fino a 2 segnalini danno da un personaggio a tua scelta a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set5-037.name: Cogsworth
set5-037.rulesText: TIME TO MOVE IT! When you play this character, chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

text.title: TIME TO MOVE IT!
text.description: When you play this character, chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

text.title: Zeit, sich zu bewegen!
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, erhält ein Charakter deiner Wahl in diesem Zug <Rasant>. (Der Charakter kann im selben Zug herausfordern, in dem er ausgespielt wird.)

text.title: Il faut arrêter ça!
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, choisissez un personnage qui gagne <Charge> pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: È ora di Muoversi!
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Lesto> per questo turno. (Può sfidare nel turno in cui viene giocato.)

set5-038.name: Merlin
set5-038.rulesText: GIVE ME TIME TO THINK When you play this character and when he leaves play, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck and the other on the bottom.

text.title: GIVE ME TIME TO THINK
text.description: When you play this character and when he leaves play, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck and the other on the bottom.

text.title: Gib mir Zeit zum Denken
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst und wenn er das Spiel verlässt, schaue dir die obersten 2 Karten deines Decks an. Lege 1 davon auf dein Deck und die andere darunter.

text.title: Laissez-moi y réfléchir
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, et lorsqu'il quitte le jeu, regardez les 2 cartes du dessus de votre pioche. Remettez-en une sur le dessus de votre pioche et l'autre en dessous.

text.title: Dammi Tempo di Pensare
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio e quando lascia il gioco, guarda le prime 2 carte del tuo mazzo. Mettine una in cima e l'altra in fondo al tuo mazzo.

en.name: Archimedes
en.text: Evasive

de.name: Archimedes
de.text: <Wendig>

fr.name: Archimède
fr.text: <Insaisissable>

it.name: Anacleto
it.text: <Sfuggente>

set5-040.name: Bruni
set5-040.rulesText:
Evasive
PARTING GIFT When this character is banished, you may draw a card.

text.title: PARTING GIFT
text.description: When this character is banished, you may draw a card.

text.title: Abschiedsgeschenk
text.description: Wenn dieser Charakter verbannt wird, darfst du 1 Karte ziehen.

text.title: Un cadeau au passage
text.description: Lorsque ce personnage est banni, vous pouvez piocher une carte.

text.title: Dono di Addio
text.description: Quando questo personaggio viene esiliato, puoi pescare una carta.

set5-041.name: Earth Giant
set5-041.rulesText: UNEARTHED When you play this character, each opponent draws a card.

text.title: UNEARTHED
text.description: When you play this character, each opponent draws a card.

text.title: Ausgegraben
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, ziehen alle gegnerischen Mitspielenden je 1 Karte.

text.title: Déterré
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, chaque adversaire pioche une carte.

text.title: Dissotterrato
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, ogni avversario pesca una carta.

set5-042.name: Gale
set5-042.rulesText: RECURRING GUST When this character is banished in a challenge, return this card to your hand.

text.title: RECURRING GUST
text.description: When this character is banished in a challenge, return this card to your hand.

text.title: Wiederkehrende Böe
text.description: Wenn dieser Charakter durch eine Herausforderung verbannt wird, nimm ihn zurück auf deine Hand.

text.title: Bourrasques persistantes
text.description: Lorsque ce personnage est banni via un défi, renvoyez-le dans votre main.

text.title: Brezza Ricorrente
text.description: Quando questo personaggio viene esiliato in una sfida, riprendi in mano questa carta.

set5-044.name: Madam Mim
set5-044.rulesText:
A LITTLE GAME When you play this character, banish her or return another chosen character of yours to your hand.
SNEAKY MOVE At the start of your turn, you may move up to 2 damage counters from this character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: A LITTLE GAME
text.description: When you play this character, banish her or return another chosen character of yours to your hand.

text.title: SNEAKY MOVE
text.description: At the start of your turn, you may move up to 2 damage counters from this character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Ein kleines Spielchen
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, musst du ihn verbannen oder einen deiner anderen Charaktere wählen und zurück auf deine Hand nehmen.

text.title: Raffinierter Schachzug
text.description: Zu Beginn deines Zuges, darfst du bis zu 2 Schadensmarker von diesem Charakter zu einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl verschieben.

text.title: Un petit jeu
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, bannissez-le ou renvoyez l'un de vos autres personnages en jeu dans votre main.

text.title: Coup en douce
text.description: Au début de votre tour, vous pouvez déplacer jusqu'à 2 dommages de ce personnage vers un personnage adverse.

text.title: Un Giochetto
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, esilialo o riprendi in mano un tuo altro personaggio a tua scelta.

text.title: Mossa Subdola
text.description: All'inizio del tuo turno, puoi spostare fino a 2 segnalini danno da questo personaggio a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set5-046.name: Anna
set5-046.rulesText:
Shift 4
EXCEPTIONAL POWER When you play this character, exert all opposing characters.

text.title: EXCEPTIONAL POWER
text.description: When you play this character, exert all opposing characters.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 4 (Du kannst 4 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Anna-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Besondere Macht
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, erschöpfe alle gegnerischen Charaktere.

text.title: <Alter> 4 (Vous pouvez payer 4 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Anna.)
Pouvoir exceptionnel
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, épuisez tous les personnages adverses.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 4 (Puoi pagare 4 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Anna.)
Potere Eccezionale
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, impegna tutti i personaggi avversari.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 3 (Du kannst 3 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Archimedes-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
<Alter> 3 (Vous pouvez payer 3 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Archimède.)
<Trasformazione> 3 (Puoi pagare 3 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Anacleto.)

set5-048.name: Elsa
set5-048.rulesText:
Rush
Evasive
CRYSTALLIZE When you play this character, exert chosen opposing character.

text.title: CRYSTALLIZE
text.description: When you play this character, exert chosen opposing character.

text.title: Kristallisieren
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, erschöpfe einen gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl.

text.title: Cristallisation
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, choisissez un personnage adverse et épuisez-le.

text.title: <Lesto> (Questo personaggio può sfidare nel turno in cui è stato giocato.)
Cristallizzare
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, impegna un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set5-049.name: Genie
set5-049.rulesText: PHENOMENAL SHOWMAN While this character is exerted, opposing characters can't ready at the start of their turn.

text.title: PHENOMENAL SHOWMAN
text.description: While this character is exerted, opposing characters can't ready at the start of their turn.

text.title: Spektakulärer Entertainer
text.description: Solange dieser Charakter erschöpft ist, werden gegnerische Charaktere zu Beginn ihres Zuges nicht bereit gemacht.

text.title: Artiste phénoménal
text.description: Tant que ce personnage est épuisé, les personnages adverses ne se redressent pas au début de leur tour.

text.title: Showman Fenomenale
text.description: Mentre questo personaggio è impegnato, i personaggi avversari non si possono preparare all'inizio del loro turno.

set5-050.name: Olaf
set5-050.rulesText:
CLEAR THE PATH For each exerted character opponents have in play, you pay 1 {I} less to play this character.
Evasive

text.title: CLEAR THE PATH
text.description: For each exerted character opponents have in play, you pay 1 {I} less to play this character.

text.title: Den Weg frei räumen
text.description: Für jeden gegnerischen erschöpften Charakter im Spiel, zahlst du 1 {I} weniger, um diesen Charakter auszuspielen.

text.title: Dégager le chemin
text.description: Jouer ce personnage vous coûte 1 {I} de moins par personnage adverse épuisé.

text.title: Spianare la Strada
text.description: Per ogni personaggio impegnato che gli avversari hanno in gioco, paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare questo personaggio.

set5-051.name: Maleficent
set5-051.rulesText: WHAT AN AWKWARD SITUATION Whenever this character quests, you may choose and discard a card to return chosen character, item, or location with cost 3 or less to their player's hand.

text.title: WHAT AN AWKWARD SITUATION
text.description: Whenever this character quests, you may choose and discard a card to return chosen character, item, or location with cost 3 or less to their player's hand.

text.title: Was für eine peinliche Situation
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du eine Karte von deiner Hand auswählen und abwerfen, um einen Charakter, Gegenstand oder Ort deiner Wahl, der 3 oder weniger kostet, auf die zugehörige Hand zurückzuschicken.

text.title: Un fâcheux oubli
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez choisir et défausser une carte. Si vous le faites, choisissez un personnage, objet ou lieu ayant un coût de 3 ou moins et renvoyez-le dans la main de son propriétaire.

text.title: Che Situazione Imbarazzante
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi scegliere e scartare una carta per far riprendere in mano al suo giocatore un personaggio, un oggetto o un luogo a tua scelta con costo 3 o inferiore.

set5-053.name: Magica De Spell
set5-053.rulesText: PLAYING WITH POWER During opponents' turns, if an effect would cause you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you don't discard.

text.title: PLAYING WITH POWER
text.description: During opponents' turns, if an effect would cause you to discard one or more cards from your hand, you don't discard.

text.title: Mit der Macht spielen
text.description: Wenn du im Zug einer gegnerischen Person 1 oder mehr Karten abwerfen müsstest, musst du keine Karten abwerfen.

text.title: Jouer avec le feu
text.description: Durant le tour de vos adversaires, si un effet devait vous faire défausser une ou plusieurs cartes de votre main, vous n'en défaussez aucune.

text.title: Giocare con il Potere
text.description: Durante il turno degli avversari, se un effetto ti farebbe scartare una o più carte dalla tua mano, non scartarne.

set5-055.name: Rafiki
set5-055.rulesText:
Rush
SURPRISING SKILL When you play this character, he gains Challenger +4 this turn. (They get +4 {S} while challenging.)

text.title: SURPRISING SKILL
text.description: When you play this character, he gains Challenger +4 this turn. (They get +4 {S} while challenging.)

text.title: Überraschende Fähigkeiten
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, erhält er in diesem Zug <Herausfordern> +4. (Während dieser Charakter herausfordert, erhält er +4 {S}).

text.title: Prendre par surprise
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, il gagne <Offensif> +4 pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: <Lesto> (Questo personaggio può sfidare nel turno in cui è stato giocato.)
Abilità Sorprendente
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, ottiene <Sfidante> +4 per questo turno. (Riceve +4 {S} mentre sta sfidando.)

set5-056.name: Anna

text.description: {E} — Paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare il tuo prossimo personaggio per questo turno.

set3-019.name: Pongo
set3-019.rulesText: TWILIGHT BARK Once per turn, you may pay 2 {I} to reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a character card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: TWILIGHT BARK
text.description: Once per turn, you may pay 2 {I} to reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a character card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: Dämmerungsbellen
text.description: Einmal pro Zug, darfst du 2 {I} bezahlen, um die oberste Karte deines Decks aufzudecken. Falls sie eine Charakterkarte ist, nimm sie auf deine Hand. Falls nicht, lege sie unter dein Deck.

text.title: Aboiement du soir
text.description: Une fois par tour, vous pouvez payer 2 {I} pour révéler la première carte de votre pioche. S'il s'agit d'une carte Personnage, ajoutez-la à votre main. Sinon, remettez-la sous votre pioche.

text.title: Telegrafo del Crepuscolo
text.description: Una volta per turno, puoi pagare 2 {I} per rivelare la prima carta del tuo mazzo. Se è una carta personaggio, aggiungila alla tua mano. Altrimenti, mettila in fondo al tuo mazzo.

set3-020.name: Queen of Hearts
set3-020.rulesText: ALL WAYS HERE ARE MY WAYS Whenever this character quests, your other Villain characters get +1 {L} this turn.

text.title: ALL WAYS HERE ARE MY WAYS
text.description: Whenever this character quests, your other Villain characters get +1 {L} this turn.

text.title: Alle Wege hier sind meine Wege
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, erhalten deine anderen Schurkinnen und Schurken in diesem Zug +1 {L}.

text.title: Tous les moyens sont à moi
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vos autres personnages Méchant gagnent +1 {L} pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Tutte le Strade Qui Sono Mie
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, i tuoi altri personaggi Cattivo ricevono +1 {L} per questo turno.

en.name: Rolly
en.text: Support

de.name: Rolly
de.text: <Unterstützen> (Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du seine {S} in diesem Zug zur {S} eines anderen Charakters deiner Wahl addieren.)

fr.name: Rolly
fr.text: <Soutien> (Lorsque ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez ajouter sa {S} à celle d'un autre personnage au choix pour le reste de ce tour.)

it.name: Rolly
it.text: <Aiutante> (Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi aggiungere la sua {S} alla {S} di un altro personaggio a tua scelta per questo turno.)

set3-022.name: Tinker Bell
set3-022.rulesText: MAKE A NEW FRIEND When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.title: MAKE
text.description: A NEW FRIEND When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.title: Neue Freunde finden
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, schaue dir die obersten 4 Karten deines Decks an. Du darfst 1 Charakterkarte daraus aufdecken und auf deine Hand nehmen. Lege die restlichen Karten in beliebiger Reihenfolge unter dein Deck.

text.title: Nouvelle amitié
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, regardez les 4 premières cartes de votre pioche. Vous pouvez révéler un personnage et l'ajouter à votre main. Remettez le reste sous votre pioche, dans l'ordre de votre choix.

text.title: Fare Amicizia
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, guarda le prime 4 carte del tuo mazzo. Puoi rivelare una carta personaggio tra quelle e aggiungerla alla tua mano. Metti il resto in fondo al tuo mazzo in qualsiasi ordine.

set3-035.name: Alice
set3-035.rulesText: CURIOUSER AND CURIOUSER {E} — Exert chosen opposing character and all other opposing characters with the same name.

text.title: CURIOUSER AND CURIOUSER
text.description: {E} — Exert chosen opposing character and all other opposing characters with the same name.

text.title: Das wird ja immer ulkiger
text.description: {E} — Erschöpfe einen gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl und alle gegnerischen Charaktere mit dem gleichen Namen.

text.title: Très très curieux
text.description: {E} — Choisissez un personnage adverse et épuisez-le, ainsi que tous les personnages adverses du même nom.

text.title: È Sempre Più Curioso
text.description: {E} — Impegna un personaggio avversario a tua scelta e tutti gli altri personaggi avversari con lo stesso nome.

set3-036.name: Chernabog's Followers
set3-036.rulesText: RESTLESS SOULS Whenever this character quests, you may banish them to draw a card.

text.title: RESTLESS SOULS
text.description: Whenever this character quests, you may banish them to draw a card.

text.title: Rastlose Seelen
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du ihn verbannen, um 1 Karte zu ziehen.

text.title: Âmes sans repos
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez le bannir pour piocher une carte.

text.title: Anime Inquiete
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi esiliarlo per pescare una carta.

set3-037.name: Diablo
set3-037.rulesText: LOOKING FOR AURORA Whenever you play a character named Maleficent, you may look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

text.title: LOOKING FOR AURORA
text.description: Whenever you play a character named Maleficent, you may look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

text.title: Suche nach Aurora
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du einen Malefiz-Charakter ausspielst, darfst du dir die oberste Karte deines Decks anschauen. Lege sie anschließend entweder auf dein Deck oder darunter.

text.title: À la recherche d'Aurore
text.description: Chaque fois que vous jouez un personnage Maléfique, vous pouvez regarder la première carte de votre pioche. Remettez-la soit sur le dessus de votre pioche, soit en dessous.

text.title: In Cerca di Aurora
text.description: Ogni volta che giochi un personaggio chiamato Malefica, puoi guardare la prima carta del tuo mazzo. Mettila in cima o in fondo al tuo mazzo.

set3-038.name: Genie
set3-038.rulesText: THREE WISHES Whenever this character quests, you may shuffle this card into your deck to draw 3 cards.

text.title: THREE WISHES
text.description: Whenever this character quests, you may shuffle this card into your deck to draw 3 cards.

text.title: Drei Wünsche
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du diese Karte in dein Deck mischen, um 3 Karten zu ziehen.

text.title: Trois vœux
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez le remélanger dans votre pioche, puis piocher 3 cartes.

text.title: Tre Desideri
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi rimescolare questa carta nel mazzo per pescare 3 carte.

text.title: BLIZZARD
text.description: {E} — Exert chosen character.

text.description: {E} — Choisissez un personnage et épuisez-le.

set3-041.name: Jafar

text.title: I AM YOUR MASTER NOW
text.description: When you play this character, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck and the other on the bottom.

text.title: Ich bin jetzt dein Meister
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, schaue dir die obersten 2 Karten deines Decks an. Lege 1 davon auf dein Deck und die andere darunter.

text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, regardez les 2 premières cartes de votre pioche. Remettez l'une d'elles sur le dessus de votre pioche et l'autre en dessous.

text.title: Sono Io il Tuo Padrone Adesso
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, guarda le prime 2 carte del tuo mazzo. Mettine una in cima al tuo mazzo e l'altra in fondo.

set3-042.name: Jafar
set3-042.rulesText:
Shift 5
Evasive
POWER BEYOND MEASURE During your turn, while this character is exerted, whenever you draw a card, gain 1 lore.

Grenzenlose Macht
text.description: Solange dieser Charakter während deines Zuges erschöpft ist, sammelst du jedes mal 1 Legende, wenn du eine Karte ziehst.

text.title: <Alter> 5 (Vous pouvez payer 5 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Jafar.)
Pouvoir sans limite
text.description: Tant que ce personnage est épuisé, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore pour chaque carte que vous piochez durant votre tour.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 5 (Puoi pagare 5 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Jafar.)
Potere Oltre Ogni Limite

text.title: POWER CLEAN
text.description: When you play this character, if you have a Sorcerer character in play, you may exert chosen opposing character. They can't ready at the start of their next turn.

text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst und mindestens einen Magier oder eine Magierin im Spiel hast, darfst du einen gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl erschöpfen. Er wird zu Beginn seines nächsten Zuges nicht bereit gemacht.

text.title: Nettoyage à fond
text.description: Si vous avez un personnage Mage en jeu lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, vous pouvez choisir un personnage adverse et l'épuiser. Il ne pourra pas être redressé au début de son prochain tour.

text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, se hai un personaggio Incantatore in gioco, puoi impegnare un personaggio avversario a tua scelta. Quel personaggio non si può preparare all'inizio del suo prossimo turno.

set3-045.rulesText:
Rush

text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, darfst du alle Besen aus deinem Ablagestapel zurück in dein Deck mischen.

text.title: <Lesto> (Questo personaggio può sfidare nel turno in cui è stato giocato.)
Pulisci Questo, Pulisci Quello
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, puoi rimescolare nel tuo mazzo tutte le carte Scopa presenti nei tuoi scarti.

set3-046.name: Magic Broom
set3-046.rulesText: CLEAN SWEEP While this character is at a location, it gets +2 {S}.

text.title: CLEAN SWEEP
text.description: While this character is at a location, it gets +2 {S}.

text.title: Sauberer Feger
text.description: Solange dieser Charakter an einem Ort ist, erhält er +2 {S}.

text.title: Nettoyeur de grandes surfaces
text.description: Tant que ce personnage se trouve sur un lieu, il gagne +2 {S}.

text.title: Pulizia Profonda
text.description: Mentre questo personaggio si trova in un luogo, riceve +2 {S}.

set3-047.name: Magic Carpet
set3-047.rulesText:
Evasive
FIND THE WAY {E} — Move a character of yours to a location for free.

text.title: FIND THE WAY

text.title: Finde den Weg
text.description: {E} — Wähle einen deiner Charaktere und bewege ihn kostenlos zu einem Ort.

text.title: Trouve le chemin
text.description: {E} — Déplacez gratuitement l'un de vos personnages sur un lieu.

text.title: Trovare la Via
text.description: {E} — Sposta gratuitamente un tuo personaggio in un luogo a tua scelta.

set3-049.name: Magica De Spell
set3-049.rulesText:
Shift 5
ALL MINE Whenever this character quests, gain lore equal to the cost of one of your items in play.

text.title: ALL MINE
text.description: Whenever this character quests, gain lore equal to the cost of one of your items in play.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 5 (Du kannst 5 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Gundel-Gaukeley-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Alles meins
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, sammle so viele Legenden, wie die Kosten eines deiner Gegenstände im Spiel betragen.

text.title: <Alter> 5 (Vous pouvez payer 5 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Miss Tick.)
Tout est à moi
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, gagnez un nombre d'éclats de Lore égal au coût d'un de vos objets en jeu.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 5 (Puoi pagare 5 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Amelia.)
Tutta Mia
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, ottieni leggenda pari al costo di uno dei tuoi oggetti in gioco.

set3-050.name: Magica De Spell
set3-050.rulesText: TELEKINESIS {E} — Return chosen item with cost equal to or less than this character's {S} to its player's hand.

text.title: TELEKINESIS
text.description: {E} — Return chosen item with cost equal to or less than this character's {S} to its player's hand.

text.title: Telekinese
text.description: {E} — Schicke einen Gegenstand deiner Wahl auf die zugehörige Hand zurück, der genauso viel oder weniger kostet wie der {S}-Wert dieses Charakters beträgt.

text.title: Télékinésie
text.description: {E} — Choisissez un objet ayant un coût inférieur ou égal à la {S} de ce personnage et renvoyez-le dans la main de son propriétaire.

text.title: Telecinesi
text.description: {E} — Fai tornare un oggetto a tua scelta con costo pari o inferiore alla {S} di questo personaggio in mano al suo giocatore.

set3-051.name: Maleficent
set3-051.rulesText:
DARK KNOWLEDGE Whenever this character quests, you may draw a card.
DIVINATION During your turn, whenever you draw a card, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.description: Whenever this character quests, you may draw a card.

text.title: DIVINATION
text.description: During your turn, whenever you draw a card, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Finsteres Wissen
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du 1 Karte ziehen.

text.title: Wahrsagung
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du in deinem Zug 1 Karte ziehst, darfst du 1 Schadensmarker von einem Charakter deiner Wahl zu einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl verschieben.

text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez piocher une carte.

text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi pescare una carta.

text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che peschi una carta, puoi spostare 1 segnalino danno da un personaggio a tua scelta a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set3-052.name: Mama Odie
set3-052.rulesText: LISTEN TO YOUR MAMA NOW Whenever this character quests, you may move up to 2 damage counters from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: LISTEN TO YOUR MAMA NOW
text.description: Whenever this character quests, you may move up to 2 damage counters from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Jetzt hört mal gut eurer Mama zu
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du bis zu 2 Schadensmarker von einem Charakter deiner Wahl zu einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl verschieben.

text.title: Écoutez bien votre Mama
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et déplacer jusqu'à 2 de ses jetons Dommage sur un personnage adverse de votre choix.

text.title: Ascoltate la Vostra Mamma Adesso
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi spostare fino a 2 segnalini danno da un personaggio a tua scelta a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set3-053.name: Pua
set3-053.rulesText: ALWAYS THERE When this character is banished, you may shuffle this card into your deck.

text.title: ALWAYS THERE
text.description: When this character is banished, you may shuffle this card into your deck.

text.title: Immer dabei
text.description: Wenn dieser Charakter verbannt wird, darfst du diese Karte in dein Deck mischen.

text.title: Toujours à tes côtés
text.description: Lorsque ce personnage est banni, vous pouvez le remélanger dans votre pioche.

text.title: Sempre Presente
text.description: Quando questo personaggio viene esiliato, puoi rimescolare questa carta nel tuo mazzo.

set3-054.name: Rafiki
set3-054.rulesText:
Challenger +3
ANCIENT SKILLS Whenever he challenges a Hyena character, this character takes no damage from the challenge.

text.title: ANCIENT SKILLS
text.description: Whenever he challenges a Hyena character, this character takes no damage from the challenge.

text.title: Uralte Kenntnisse
text.description: Dieser Charakter erhält keinen Schaden durch Herausforderungen, während er eine Hyäne herausfordert.

text.title: Talent Ancestral
text.description: Lorsque ce personnage défie un personnage Hyène, il ne subit aucun dommage pour ce défi.

text.title: Antiche Abilità
text.description: Ogni volta che sfida un personaggio Iena, questo personaggio non subisce danni dalla sfida.

set3-055.name: Stratos
set3-055.rulesText:
Evasive
CYCLONE {E} — Gain lore equal to the number of Titan characters you have in play.

text.title: Cyclone

text.title: Ciclone
text.description: {E} — Ottieni leggenda pari al numero di personaggi Titano che hai in gioco.

text.description: This character can't challenge or quest unless it is at a location.

text.description: Dieser Charakter kann nicht herausfordern oder erkunden, außer er ist an einem Ort.

text.title: Qui donc vient troubler mon repos?
text.description: Ce personnage ne peut ni défier, ni être envoyé à l'aventure à moins qu'il ne soit présent sur un lieu.

text.title: Chi Osa Disturbare il Mio Riposo?
text.description: Questo personaggio non può sfidare o andare all'avventura a meno che non si trovi in un luogo.

set3-059.name: Ursula
set3-059.rulesText: YOU'RE TOO LATE Whenever this character quests, chosen opposing character can't ready at the start of their next turn.

text.title: Ormai È Troppo Tardi
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, un personaggio avversario a tua scelta non si può preparare all'inizio del suo prossimo turno.

set3-069.name: Cubby

C'est ça, grand chef
text.description: Tant que ce personnage est épuisé, vos personnages avec <Rempart> gagnent +1 {L} et <Résistance> +1.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 4 (Puoi pagare 4 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Little John.)
OK, Buffone

Verkleidet

Déguisé

text.title: Camuffato

Resist +2
STONE SKIN {E} — Chosen character gains Resist +2 this turn.

Steinhaut

text.title: Pelle di Pietra
text.description: {E} — Un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Resistere> +2 per questo turno.

set3-181.name: Mickey Mouse
set3-181.rulesText: LET'S TAKE A LOOK This character gets +1 {S} for each location you have in play.

text.description: A LOOK This character gets +1 {S} for each location you have in play.

text.title: Schauen wir uns das mal an

text.title: Allons jeter un œil

text.title: Diamo un'Occhiata
text.description: Questo personaggio riceve +1 {S} per ogni luogo che hai in gioco.

set3-182.name: Mickey Mouse
set3-182.rulesText: SOUND THE CALL {E}, 2 {I} — Play a character for free.

text.title: SOUND THE CALL
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Play a character for free.

text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Spiele einen Charakter kostenlos aus.

text.title: Sonne l'appel
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Jouez gratuitement un personnage.

text.title: Dare il Segnale
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Gioca un personaggio gratis.

set3-183.name: Minnie Mouse
set3-183.rulesText: JOURNEY While this character is at a location, she gets +2 {S}.

text.title: JOURNEY
text.description: While this character is at a location, she gets +2 {S}.

text.title: Reise
text.description: Solange dieser Charakter an einem Ort ist, erhält er +2 {S}.

text.title: Voyage
text.description: Tant que ce personnage se trouve sur un lieu, il gagne +2 {S}.

text.title: Viaggio
text.description: Mentre questo personaggio si trova in un luogo, riceve +2 {S}.

set3-184.name: Mr. Smee
set3-184.rulesText: OH DEAR, DEAR, DEAR At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted and you don't have a Captain character in play, deal 1 damage to this character.

text.title: OH DEAR, DEAR, DEAR
text.description: At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted and you don't have a Captain character in play, deal 1 damage to this character.

text.title: Oje, Käpt'n
text.description: Am Ende deines Zuges, wenn dieser Charakter erschöpft ist und du keinen Kapitän oder keine Kapitänin im Spiel hast, füge diesem Charakter 1 Schaden zu.

text.title: Oh la la la la
text.description: À la fin de votre tour, si ce personnage est épuisé et que vous n'avez aucun personnage Capitaine en jeu, infligez-lui 1 dommage.

text.title: Oh Caro, Caro Capitan Uncino
text.description: Alla fine del tuo turno, se questo personaggio è impegnato e non hai un personaggio Capitano in gioco, infliggi 1 danno a questo personaggio.

fr.name: Mufasa
fr.version: Champion de la Terre des Lions

set3-187.name: Pyros
set3-187.rulesText: ERUPTION During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may ready chosen character.

text.title: ERUPTION
text.description: During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may ready chosen character.

text.title: Eruption
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter in deinem Zug durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, darfst du einen Charakter deiner Wahl bereit machen.

text.title: Éruption
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage en bannit un autre via un défi durant votre tour, vous pouvez choisir et redresser un personnage.

text.title: Eruzione
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che questo personaggio esilia un altro personaggio in una sfida, puoi preparare un personaggio a tua scelta.

set3-188.name: Razoul
set3-188.rulesText: LOOKY HERE While this character has no damage, he gets +2 {S}.

text.title: LOOKY HERE
text.description: While this character has no damage, he gets +2 {S}.

text.title: Seht euch das an
text.description: Solange dieser Charakter unbeschädigt ist, erhält er +2 {S}.

text.title: Regardez
text.description: Tant que ce personnage n'a aucun jeton Dommage sur lui, il gagne +2 {S}.

text.title: Guardate un Po'
text.description: Mentre questo personaggio non ha danno, riceve +2 {S}.

set3-190.name: Robin Hood
set3-190.rulesText:
Shift 3
SKILLED COMBATANT During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.
THE GOOD OF OTHERS When this character is banished in a challenge, you may draw a card.

text.title: SKILLED COMBATANT
text.description: During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.

text.title: THE GOOD OF OTHERS
text.description: When this character is banished in a challenge, you may draw a card.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 3 (Du kannst 3 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Robin-Hood-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Erfahrener Kämpfer
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter in deinem Zug durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, sammelst du 2 Legenden.

text.title: Das Wohl der anderen
text.description: Wenn dieser Charakter durch eine Herausforderung verbannt wird, darfst du 1 Karte ziehen.

text.title: <Alter> 3 (Vous pouvez payer 3 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Robin des Bois.)
Combattant émérite
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage en bannit un autre via un défi durant votre tour, gagnez 2 éclats de Lore.

text.title: Pour le bien d'autrui
text.description: Si ce personnage est banni via un défi, vous pouvez piocher une carte.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 3 (Puoi pagare 3 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Robin Hood.)
Combattente Esperto
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che questo personaggio esilia un altro personaggio in una sfida, ottieni 2 leggenda.

text.title: Per il Bene degli Altri
text.description: Quando questo personaggio viene esiliato in una sfida, puoi pescare una carta.

set3-191.name: Sheriff of Nottingham
set3-191.rulesText: TAXES SHOULD HURT Whenever you discard a card, you may deal 1 damage to chosen opposing character.

text.title: TAXES SHOULD HURT
text.description: Whenever you discard a card, you may deal 1 damage to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Steuern müssen weh tun
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du eine Karte abwirfst, darfst du einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl 1 Schaden zufügen.

text.title: Les taxes c'est douloureux
text.description: Chaque fois que vous défaussez une carte, vous pouvez choisir un personnage adverse et lui infliger 1 dommage.

text.title: È Giusto Che Sia Così
text.description: Ogni volta che scarti una carta, puoi infliggere 1 danno a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set3-192.name: Simba
set3-192.rulesText: STEP DOWN OR FIGHT When you play this character and whenever he banishes another character in a challenge during your turn, you may choose one: • Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard 2 cards. • Deal 2 damage to chosen character.

text.title: STEP DOWN OR FIGHT
text.description: When you play this character and whenever he banishes another character in a challenge during your turn, you may choose one: • Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard 2 cards. • Deal 2 damage to chosen character.

text.title: Dank ab oder kämpf
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst und jedes Mal, wenn er in deinem Zug durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, darfst du eine Möglichkeit auswählen:

text.title: • Ziehe 2 Karten. Wähle danach 2 Karten aus deiner Hand und wirf sie ab.
• Füge einem Charakter deiner Wahl 2 Schaden zu.
Tu te soumets ou tu te bats
text.description: Chaque fois que vous jouez ce personnage ou qu'il en bannit un autre via un défi durant votre tour, choisissez entre:

text.title: • Piochez 2 cartes, puis choisissez et défaussez 2 cartes.
• Choisissez un personnage et infligez-lui 2 dommages.
O ti Fai da Parte, o Dovrai Affrontarmi
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio e ogni volta che esilia un altro personaggio in una sfida durante il tuo turno, scegli uno:

text.title: • Pesca 2 carte, poi scegli e scarta 2 carte.
• Infliggi 2 danni a un personaggio a tua scelta.

set3-193.name: Simba
set3-193.rulesText: TRIUMPHANT STANCE During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, chosen opposing character can't challenge during their next turn.

text.title: TRIUMPHANT STANCE
text.description: During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, chosen opposing character can't challenge during their next turn.

text.title: Triumphale Haltung
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter in deinem Zug durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, wähle einen gegnerischen Charakter. Er kann in seinem nächsten Zug nicht herausfordern.

text.title: Pose triomphante
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage en bannit un autre via un défi durant votre tour, choisissez un personnage adverse, il ne pourra pas défier durant son prochain tour.

text.title: Posa Trionfale
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che questo personaggio esilia un altro personaggio in una sfida, un personaggio avversario a tua scelta non può sfidare durante il suo prossimo turno.

set3-194.name: Thaddeus E. Klang
set3-194.rulesText: MY TEETH ARE SHARPER Whenever this character quests while at a location, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

text.title: MY TEETH ARE SHARPER
text.description: Whenever this character quests while at a location, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

text.title: Meine Zähne sind schärfer
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter an einem Ort erkundet, darfst du einem Charakter deiner Wahl 1 Schaden zufügen.

text.title: Mâchoire acérée
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure et qu'il se trouve sur un lieu, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et lui infliger 1 dommage.

text.title: I Miei Denti Sono Più Affilati
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura mentre si trova in un luogo, puoi infliggere 1 danno a un personaggio a tua scelta.

set3-205-enchanted.name: Chernabog
set3-205-enchanted.rulesText:
THE POWER OF EVIL For each character card in your discard, you pay 1 {I} less to play this character.
SUMMON THE SPIRITS When you play this character, shuffle all character cards from your discard into your deck.

text.title: THE POWER OF EVIL
text.description: For each character card in your discard, you pay 1 {I} less to play this character.

text.title: SUMMON THE SPIRITS
text.description: When you play this character, shuffle all character cards from your discard into your deck.

text.title: Die Macht des Bösen
text.description: Für jede Charakterkarte in deinem Ablagestapel zahlst du 1 {I} weniger, um diesen Charakter auszuspielen.

text.title: Die Geister beschwören
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, mische alle Charakterkarten aus deinem Ablagestapel zurück in dein Deck.

text.title: Le pouvoir du Mal
text.description: Ce personnage vous coûte 1 {I} de moins pour chaque carte Personnage dans votre défausse.

text.title: Invocation des esprits
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, remettez tous les personnages de votre défausse dans votre pioche, puis mélangez-la.

text.title: Il Potere del Male
text.description: Per ogni carta personaggio nei tuoi scarti, paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare questo personaggio.

text.title: Evocare gli Spiriti
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, rimescola nel tuo mazzo tutte le carte personaggio nei tuoi scarti.

set3-206-enchanted.name: Kida
set3-206-enchanted.rulesText:
Shift 3

text.title: PERHAPS WE CAN SAVE OUR FUTURE
text.description: When you play this character, all characters get -3 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 3 (Du kannst 3 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Kida-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Vielleicht können wir unsere Zukunft retten
text.description: Wenn du diesen Charakter ausspielst, gib allen Charakteren bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges -3 {S}.

text.title: <Alter> 3 (Vous pouvez payer 3 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Kida.)
Peut-être pourrons-nous sauver notre avenir
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez ce personnage, tous les personnages subissent -3 {S} jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 3 (Puoi pagare 3 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Kida.)
Forse Riusciremo a Salvare il Nostro Futuro
text.description: Quando giochi questo personaggio, tutti i personaggi ricevono -3 {S} fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

set3-208-enchanted.name: Jafar
set3-208-enchanted.rulesText:
Shift 5
Evasive
POWER BEYOND MEASURE During your turn, while this character is exerted, whenever you draw a card, gain 1 lore.

text.title: POWER BEYOND MEASURE
text.description: During your turn, while this character is exerted, whenever you draw a card, gain 1 lore.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 5 (Du kannst 5 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Dschafar-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Grenzenlose Macht

text.title: <Alter> 5 (Vous pouvez payer 5 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Jafar.)
Pouvoir sans limite
text.description: Tant que ce personnage est épuisé, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore pour chaque carte que vous piochez durant votre tour.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 5 (Puoi pagare 5 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Jafar.)
Potere Oltre Ogni Limite
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, mentre questo personaggio è impegnato, ottieni 1 leggenda ogni volta che peschi una carta.

set3-209-enchanted.name: Maleficent
set3-209-enchanted.rulesText:
DARK KNOWLEDGE Whenever this character quests, you may draw a card.
DIVINATION During your turn, whenever you draw a card, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: DARK KNOWLEDGE
text.description: Whenever this character quests, you may draw a card.

text.title: DIVINATION
text.description: During your turn, whenever you draw a card, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Finsteres Wissen
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter erkundet, darfst du 1 Karte ziehen.

text.title: Wahrsagung
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du in deinem Zug 1 Karte ziehst, darfst du 1 Schadensmarker von einem Charakter deiner Wahl zu einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl verschieben.

text.title: Savoir obscur
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez piocher une carte.

text.title: Divination
text.description: Chaque fois que vous piochez une carte durant votre tour, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et déplacer 1 de ses jetons Dommage sur un personnage adverse de votre choix.

text.title: Sapere Oscuro
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio va all'avventura, puoi pescare una carta.

text.title: Divinazione
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che peschi una carta, puoi spostare 1 segnalino danno da un personaggio a tua scelta a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set3-211-enchanted.name: Morph
set3-211-enchanted.rulesText: MIMICRY You may play any character with Shift on this character as if this character had any name.

text.title: MIMICRY
text.description: You may play any character with Shift on this character as if this character had any name.

text.title: Mimikry
text.description: Du kannst jeden Charakter mit der Gestaltwandel-Fähigkeit auf diesen Charakter ausspielen, als würde dieser Charakter jeden Namen haben.

text.title: Mimétisme
text.description: Vous pouvez jouer n'importe quel personnage avec <Alter> sur ce personnage, quel que soit son nom.

text.title: Imitazione
text.description: Puoi giocare qualsiasi personaggio con <Trasformazione> su questo personaggio, come se avesse qualsiasi nome.

set3-212-enchanted.name: Ursula
set3-212-enchanted.rulesText: WHAT A DEAL Whenever this character sings a song, you may play that song again from your discard for free, then put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: WHAT
text.description: A DEAL Whenever this character sings a song, you may play that song again from your discard for free, then put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: Was für ein Deal
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter ein Lied singt, darfst du dieses Lied erneut von deinem Ablagestapel kostenlos ausspielen. Lege es danach unter dein Deck.

text.title: Quel contrat
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage chante une chanson, vous pouvez rejouer cette chanson gratuitement depuis votre défausse, puis la remettre sous votre pioche.

text.title: Che Affare
text.description: Ogni volta che questo personaggio canta una canzone, puoi giocare nuovamente quella canzone dagli scarti gratis, poi mettila in fondo al tuo mazzo.

set3-214-enchanted.name: Captain Hook
set3-214-enchanted.rulesText:
NEMESIS During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, ready this character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
MAN-TO-MAN Characters named Peter Pan lose Evasive and can't gain Evasive.

text.title: NEMESIS
text.description: During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, ready this character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.

text.title: MAN-TO-MAN
text.description: Characters named Peter Pan lose Evasive and can't gain Evasive.

text.title: Nemesis
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter in deinem Zug durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, mache diesen Charakter bereit. Er kann in diesem Zug nicht mehr erkunden.

text.title: Mann gegen Mann
text.description: Alle Peter-Pan-Charaktere verlieren <Wendig> und können <Wendig> nicht mehr erhalten.

text.title: Némésis
text.description: Chaque fois que ce personnage en bannit un autre via un défi durant votre tour, redressez-le. Il ne peut pas être envoyé à l'aventure pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Combat singulier
text.description: Les personnages Peter Pan perdent <Insaisissable> et ne peuvent pas gagner <Insaisissable>.

text.title: Nemesi
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che questo personaggio esilia un altro personaggio in una sfida, preparalo. Non può andare all'avventura per il resto di questo turno.

text.title: Uomo a Uomo
text.description: I personaggi chiamati Peter Pan perdono <Sfuggente> e non possono ottenere <Sfuggente>.

set3-215-enchanted.name: Peter Pan
set3-215-enchanted.rulesText:
Shift 4
Evasive
YOU'RE NEXT! Whenever he challenges a Pirate character, this character takes no damage from the challenge.

text.title: YOU'RE NEXT!
text.description: Whenever he challenges a Pirate character, this character takes no damage from the challenge.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 4 (Du kannst 4 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Peter-Pan-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Du bist der Nächste!
text.description: Dieser Charakter erhält keinen Schaden durch Herausforderungen, während er einen Piraten oder eine Piratin herausfordert.

text.title: <Alter> 4 (Vous pouvez payer 4 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Peter Pan.)
Au suivant!
text.description: Ce personnage ne subit pas de dommage lorsqu'il défie un personnage Pirate.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 4 (Puoi pagare 4 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Peter Pan.)
Sei il Prossimo!
text.description: Ogni volta che sfida un personaggio Pirata, questo personaggio non subisce danni dalla sfida.

set3-217-enchanted.name: Gramma Tala
set3-217-enchanted.rulesText:
Shift 5
DO YOU KNOW WHO YOU ARE? Whenever a card is put into your inkwell, gain 1 lore.

text.title: DO YOU KNOW WHO YOU ARE?
text.description: Whenever a card is put into your inkwell, gain 1 lore.

text.title: <Gestaltwandel> 5 (Du kannst 5 {I} zahlen, um diesen Charakter auf einen deiner Gramma-Tala-Charaktere auszuspielen.)
Weißt du, wer du bist?
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn eine Karte in deinen Tintenvorrat gelegt wird, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: <Alter> 5 (Vous pouvez payer 5 {I} pour jouer ce personnage sur l'un de vos personnages Grand-mère Tala.)
Sais-tu qui tu es?
text.description: Chaque fois qu'une carte est placée dans votre réserve d'encre, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: <Trasformazione> 5 (Puoi pagare 5 {I} per giocare questa carta sopra a uno dei tuoi personaggi chiamato Nonna Tala.)
Può Rivelarti Solo il Tuo Cuore Chi Tu Sia
text.description: Ogni volta che una carta vene aggiunta al tuo calamaio, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set3-218-enchanted.name: Scrooge McDuck
set3-218-enchanted.rulesText:
I'M GOING HOME! During your turn, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
I DIDN'T GET RICH BY BEING STUPID During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may play an item for free.

text.title: I'M GOING HOME!
text.description: During your turn, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

text.title: I DIDN'T GET RICH BY BEING STUPID
text.description: During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may play an item for free.

text.title: Ich gehe nach Hause!
text.description: In deinem Zug erhält dieser Charakter <Wendig>. (Er kann Charaktere mit Wendig herausfordern.)

text.title: Ich bin ja nicht reich geworden, weil ich dumm bin
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn dieser Charakter in deinem Zug durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, darfst du einen Gegenstand kostenlos ausspielen.

fr.name: Balthazar Picsou
fr.version: Canard le plus riche du monde

text.title: Je rentre chez moi
text.description: Durant votre tour, ce personnage gagne <Insaisissable>. (Il peut défier les personnages avec Insaisissable.)

text.title: Je ne suis pas devenu riche en étant stupide

text.description: Charaktere an diesem Ort erhalten <Rasant>. (Die Charaktere können im selben Zug herausfordern, in dem sie ausgespielt werden.)

text.title: Alle an Deck!
text.description: Deine Piratinnen und Piraten können sich kostenlos zu diesem Ort bewegen.

text.title: Je veux l'avoir mort ou vif!
text.description: Les personnages sur ce lieu gagnent <Charge>. (Ces personnages peuvent défier le tour où ils sont joués.)

text.title: Tout le monde à son poste!
text.description: Vos personnages Pirate peuvent être déplacés gratuitement sur ce lieu.

text.title: Animo, Manigoldi!
text.description: I personaggi ottengono <Lesto> mentre si trovano in questo luogo. (Possono sfidare nel turno in cui vengono giocati.)

text.title: Tutti in Coperta!
text.description: I tuoi personaggi Pirata possono spostarsi in questo luogo gratis.

set3-136.name: RLS Legacy
set3-136.rulesText:
THIS IS OUR SHIP Characters gain Evasive while here.
HEAVE TOGETHER NOW If you have a character here, you pay 2 {I} less to move a character of yours here.

text.title: THIS IS OUR SHIP
text.description: Characters gain Evasive while here.

text.title: HEAVE TOGETHER NOW
text.description: If you have a character here, you pay 2 {I} less to move a character of yours here.

text.title: Das ist unser Schiff
text.description: Charaktere an diesem Ort erhalten <Wendig>. (Nur Charaktere mit Wendig können diese Charaktere herausfordern.)

text.title: Langsam ablassen
text.description: Wenn du mindestens einen Charakter an diesem Ort hast, zahlst du 2 {I} weniger, um Charaktere an diesen Ort zu bewegen.

text.title: C'est notre bateau
text.description: Les personnages sur ce lieu gagnent <Insaisissable>. (Seuls les personnages avec Insaisissable peuvent défier ces personnages.)

text.title: Ne travaillez pas les uns contre les autres
text.description: Tant que l'un de vos personnages se trouve sur ce lieu, y déplacer un personnage vous coûte 2 {I} de moins.

text.title: Questa è la Nostra Nave
text.description: I personaggi ottengono <Sfuggente> mentre si trovano in questo luogo. (Solo altri personaggi con Sfuggente possono sfidarli.)

text.title: Tirate Tutti Insieme
text.description: Se hai un personaggio in questo luogo, paga 2 {I} in meno per spostare un tuo personaggio in questo luogo.

set3-168.name: Belle's House
set3-168.rulesText: LABORATORY If you have a character here, you pay 1 {I} less to play items.

text.title: LABORATORY
text.description: If you have a character here, you pay 1 {I} less to play items.

text.title: Laboratorium
text.description: Solange du mindestens einen Charakter an diesem Ort hast, zahlst du 1 {I} weniger, um Gegenstände auszuspielen.

text.title: Laboratoire
text.description: Tant que vous avez au moins un personnage sur ce lieu, les objets vous coûtent 1 {I} de moins.

text.title: Laboratorio
text.description: Mentre hai uno o più personaggi in questo luogo, paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare gli oggetti.

set3-170.name: Motunui
set3-170.rulesText: REINCARNATION Whenever a character is banished while here, you may put that card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: REINCARNATION
text.description: Whenever a character is banished while here, you may put that card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: Reinkarnation
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn einer deiner Charaktere an diesem Ort verbannt wird, darfst du jenen verdeckt und erschöpft in deinen Tintenvorrat legen.

text.title: Réincarnation
text.description: Chaque fois qu'un personnage sur ce lieu est banni, vous pouvez le placer dans votre réserve d'encre, face cachée et épuisé.

text.title: Reincarnazione
text.description: Ogni volta che un personaggio viene esiliato mentre si trova in questo luogo, puoi aggiungere quella carta al tuo calamaio, a faccia in giù e impegnata.

set3-202.name: Maui's Place of Exile
set3-202.rulesText: ISOLATED Characters gain Resist +1 while here.

text.title: ISOLATED
text.description: Characters gain Resist +1 while here.

text.title: Isoliert
text.description: Charaktere an diesem Ort erhalten <Robust> +1. (Reduziere jeglichen Schaden, der den Charakteren zugefügt wird, um 1.)

text.title: Isolé
text.description: Les personnages sur ce lieu gagnent <Résistance> +1.

text.title: Isolata
text.description: I personaggi ottengono <Resistere> +1 mentre si trovano in questo luogo.

set3-204.name: The Bayou
set3-204.rulesText: SHOW ME THE WAY Whenever a character quests while here, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

text.title: SHOW ME THE WAY
text.description: Whenever a character quests while here, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

text.title: Wir nehmen euch jetzt mit
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn einer deiner Charaktere an diesem Ort erkundet, darfst du 1 Karte ziehen. Wähle danach 1 Karte aus deiner Hand und wirf sie ab.

text.title: Montre-moi le chemin
text.description: Chaque fois qu'un personnage sur ce lieu est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez piocher une carte, puis choisissez et défaussez une carte.

text.title: Mostrami la Via
text.description: Ogni volta che un personaggio va all'avventura mentre si trova in questo luogo, puoi pescare una carta, poi scegli e scarta una carta.

set3-207-enchanted.name: Pride Lands
set3-207-enchanted.rulesText:
WE ARE ALL CONNECTED Characters get +2 {W} while here.
LION HOME If you have a Prince or King character here, you pay 1 {I} less to play characters.

text.title: WE ARE ALL CONNECTED
text.description: Characters get +2 {W} while here.

text.title: LION HOME
text.description: If you have a Prince or King character here, you pay 1 {I} less to play characters.

text.title: Wir sind alle eins
text.description: Charaktere an diesem Ort erhalten +2 {W}.

text.title: Zuhause der Löwen
text.description: Wenn du mindestens einen Prinz oder einen König an diesem Ort hast, zahlst du 1 {I} weniger, um Charaktere auszuspielen.

text.title: C'est comme les maillons d'une chaîne
text.description: Les personnages sur ce lieu gagnent +2 {W}.

text.title: Demeure des Lions
text.description: Si un personnage Prince ou Roi se trouve sur ce lieu, jouer des personnages vous coûte 1 {I} de moins.

text.title: Siamo Tutti Collegati
text.description: I personaggi ricevono +2 {W} mentre si trovano in questo luogo.

text.title: Casa del Leone
text.description: Se un personaggio Principe o Re si trova in questo luogo, paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare i personaggi.

set3-213-enchanted.name: Kuzco's Palace
set3-213-enchanted.rulesText: CITY WALLS Whenever a character is challenged and banished while here, banish the challenging character.

text.title: CITY WALLS
text.description: Whenever a character is challenged and banished while here, banish the challenging character.

text.title: Stadtmauern
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn einer deiner Charaktere an diesem Ort herausgefordert und verbannt wird, verbanne den herausfordernden Charakter.

text.title: Murs de la cité
text.description: Chaque fois qu'un personnage sur ce lieu est défié et banni, bannissez le personnage qui l'a défié.

text.title: Mura Cittadine
text.description: Ogni volta che un personaggio viene sfidato ed esiliato mentre si trova in questo luogo, esilia il personaggio che lo ha sfidato.

set3-p1-027-promo.rulesText:
LOOK ALIVE, YOU SWABS! Characters gain Rush while here. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
ALL HANDS ON DECK! Your Pirate characters may move here for free.

text.title: ALL HANDS ON DECK!
text.description: Your Pirate characters may move here for free.
