set13-036.name: Powhatan's Staff
set13-036.rulesText: STEP FORWARD {}, 1{} — The next character you play this turn enters play exerted and gains Bodyguard until the start of your next turn. (An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

text.title: STEP FORWARD
text.description: {}, 1{} — The next character you play this turn enters play exerted and gains Bodyguard until the start of your next turn. (An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)

text.title: Tritt vor
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Der nächste Charakter, den du in diesem Zug ausspielst, kommt erschöpft ins Spiel und erhält <Beschützen>. (Gegnerische Charaktere müssen beim Herausfordern deiner Charaktere zuerst deine Charaktere mit Beschützen wählen, wenn möglich.)

text.title: Faire un pas en avant
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Le prochain personnage que vous jouez ce tour-ci entre en jeu épuisé et gagne <Rempart> jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour. (Lorsqu'il défie l'un de vos personnages, un personnage adverse doit, s'il le peut, choisir l'un de vos personnages avec Rempart.)

text.title: Farsi Avanti
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Il prossimo personaggio che giochi per questo turno entra in gioco impegnato e ottiene <Guardiano> fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno. (Un personaggio avversario che sfida uno dei tuoi personaggi deve sceglierne uno con Guardiano, se possibile.)

set13-071.name: Magical Hunny Staff
set13-071.rulesText:
GIFT OF THE HIVE Once during your turn, you may pay 1 {} to give chosen character of yours the Hunny classification until the start of your next turn.

SPELL OF SWIFTNESS {}, 2 {} — Chosen Hunny character of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.

text.title: GIFT OF THE HIVE
text.description: Once during your turn, you may pay 1 {} to give chosen character of yours the Hunny classification until the start of your next turn.

text.title: SPELL OF SWIFTNESS
text.description: {}, 2 {} — Chosen Hunny character of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Geschenk des Schwarms
text.description: Einmal während deines Zuges darfst du 1 {I} bezahlen, um einen deiner Charaktere zu wählen. Jener erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges die Klassifizierung Honig.

text.title: Zauber der Gewandtheit
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Wähle einen deiner Honig-Charaktere. Jener erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Wendig>.

text.title: Don de la ruche
text.description: Une fois durant votre tour, vous pouvez payer 1 {I} pour choisir l'un de vos personnages et lui donner la classification Miel jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Sort de célérité
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Choisissez l'un de vos personnages Miel qui gagne <Insaisissable> jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Dono dell'Alveare
text.description: Una volta durante il tuo turno, puoi pagare 1 {I} per dare a un tuo personaggio a tua scelta la classificazione Miele fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

text.title: Incantesimo di Velocità
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Un tuo personaggio Miele a tua scelta ottiene <Sfuggente> fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno. (Solo altri personaggi con Sfuggente possono sfidarlo.)

set13-106.name: My Adventure Book
set13-106.rulesText: NEW MEMORIES {}, 1{} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a non-character card or a character card named Kevin, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: New Memories
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a non-character card or a character card named Kevin, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: Neue Erinnerungen
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Decke die oberste Karte deines Decks auf. Falls sie keine Charakterkarte oder eine Charakterkarte namens Kevin ist, nimm sie auf deine Hand. Falls nicht, lege sie unter dein Deck.

text.title: Nouveaux souvenirs
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Révélez la carte du dessus de votre pioche. S'il s'agit d'une carte non-Personnage ou d'une carte Personnage nommée Kevin, ajoutez-la à votre main. Sinon, placez-la sous votre pioche.

text.title: Nuovi Ricordi
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Rivela la prima carta del tuo mazzo. Se è una carta non personaggio o una carta personaggio chiamata Kevin, aggiungila alla tua mano. Altrimenti, mettila in fondo al tuo mazzo.

set13-139.name: Scream Canister
set13-139.rulesText: \Erratic Screams\ {E}, 2 {I} — Exert all cards in your inkwell. Exert chosen opposing character with 2 {S} or less.

text.title: Erratic Screams
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Exert all cards in your inkwell. Exert chosen opposing character with 2 {S} or less.

text.title: Unkontrollierbare Schreie
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Erschöpfe alle Karten in deinem Tintenvorrat. Erschöpfe einen gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl mit 2 oder weniger {S}.

text.title: Cris erratiques
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Épuisez toutes les cartes de votre réserve d'encre. Choisissez un personnage adverse ayant 2 {S} ou moins et épuisez-le.

text.title: Urla Imprevedibili
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Impegna tutte le carte nel tuo calamaio. Impegna un personaggio avversario a tua scelta con 2 {S} o inferiore.

set13-140.name: Bunch of Balloons
set13-140.rulesText:
\Float Away\ When you play this item, choose a location of yours. While this item is in play, that location gains <Evasive>. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge it.)

\Out of Sight\ 3 {I} — Return this item to your hand.

text.title: Float Away
text.description: When you play this item, choose a location of yours. While this item is in play, that location gains <Evasive>. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge it.)

text.title: Out of Sight
text.description: 3 {I} — Return this item to your hand.

text.title: Wegschweben
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, wähle einen deiner Orte. Solange dieser Gegenstand im Spiel ist, erhält jener Ort <Wendig>. (Nur Charaktere mit Wendig können den Ort herausfordern.)

text.title: Außer Sichtweite
text.description: 3 {I} — Nimm diesen Gegenstand zurück auf deine Hand.

text.title: S'envoler
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, choisissez l'un de vos lieux. Tant que cet objet est en jeu, le lieu ainsi choisi gagne <Insaisissable>. (Seuls les personnages avec Insaisissable peuvent le défier.)

text.title: Hors de vue
text.description: 3 {I} — Renvoyez cet objet dans votre main.

text.title: Volare Via
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, scegli un tuo luogo. Mentre questo oggetto è in gioco, quel luogo ottiene <Sfuggente>. (Solo i personaggi con Sfuggente possono sfidarlo.)

text.title: Non Più in Vista
text.description: 3 {I} — Riprendi in mano questo oggetto.

set13-173.name: Translation Collar
set13-173.rulesText: YOU ARE MY FRIEND {}, 1{} — Chosen character gets +1 {} and gains Support this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their {} to another chosen character's {} this turn.)

text.title: You Are My Friend
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gets +1 {L} and gains <Support> this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)

text.title: Du bist mein Freund
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Ein Charakter deiner Wahl erhält in diesem Zug +1 {L} und <Unterstützen>. (Jedes Mal, wenn er erkundet, darfst du seine {S} in diesem Zug zur {S} eines anderen Charakters deiner Wahl addieren.)

text.title: Tu es mon ami
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Choisissez un personnage qui gagne +1 {L} et <Soutien> pour le reste de ce tour. (Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez ajouter sa {S} à celle d'un autre personnage au choix pour le reste de ce tour.)

text.title: Sei Mio Amico
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Un personaggio a tua scelta riceve +1 {L} e ottiene <Aiutante> per questo turno. (Ogni volta che va all'avventura, puoi aggiungere la sua {S} alla {S} di un altro personaggio a tua scelta per questo turno.)

set13-174.name: Big Book of Hunny
set13-174.rulesText: INVOKE HUNNY {}, 2 {} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Hunny card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: INVOKE HUNNY
text.description: {}, 2 {} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Hunny card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: Honig beschwören
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Decke die oberste Karte deines Decks auf. Falls sie eine Honig-Karte ist, nimm sie auf deine Hand. Falls nicht, lege sie unter dein Deck.

text.title: Invocation de miel
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Révélez la carte du dessus de votre pioche. S'il s'agit d'une carte Miel, ajoutez-la à votre main. Sinon, placez-la sous votre pioche.

text.title: Invocazione del Miele
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Rivela la prima carta del tuo mazzo. Se è una carta Miele, aggiungila alla tua mano. Altrimenti, mettila in fondo al tuo mazzo.

set13-204.name: Discarded Armor
set13-204.rulesText: FOUND EQUIPMENT exert — If you discarded a card this turn, chosen character of yours gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Found Equipment
text.description: {E} — If you discarded a card this turn, chosen character of yours gains <Resist> +1 until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Gefundene Ausstattung
text.description: {E} — Falls du in diesem Zug eine Karte abgeworfen hast, wähle einen deiner Charaktere. Jener erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Robust> +1. (Reduziere jeglichen Schaden, der ihm zugefügt wird, um 1.)

text.title: Équipement récupéré
text.description: {E} — Si vous avez défaussé une carte ce tour-ci, choisissez l'un de vos personnages qui gagne <Résistance> +1 jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Equipaggiamento Rinvenuto
text.description: {E} — Se hai scartato una carta in questo turno, un tuo personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Resistere> +1 fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

set12-033.name: Safety Rope
set12-033.rulesText:
GRAB HOLD! When you play this item, you may put a character card from your discard on the top of your deck.
PACK IT UP At the end of your turn, you may banish this item to draw a card.

text.title: GRAB HOLD!
text.description: When you play this item, you may put a character card from your discard on the top of your deck.

text.title: PACK IT UP
text.description: At the end of your turn, you may banish this item to draw a card.

text.title: Festhalten!
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, darfst du 1 Charakterkarte aus deinem Ablagestapel zurück auf dein Deck legen.

text.title: Pack es ein
text.description: Am Ende deines Zuges darfst du diesen Gegenstand verbannen, um 1 Karte zu ziehen.

text.title: Accroche-toi!
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, vous pouvez placer sur votre pioche une carte Personnage de votre défausse.

text.title: Range ça
text.description: À la fin de votre tour, vous pouvez bannir cet objet pour piocher une carte.

text.title: Afferrala!
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, puoi mettere una carta personaggio dai tuoi scarti in cima al tuo mazzo.

text.title: Mettila Via
text.description: Alla fine del tuo turno, puoi esiliare questo oggetto per pescare una carta.

set12-066.name: Super Suit
set12-066.rulesText:
SIMPLE, ELEGANT When you play this item, if you have a Hero character in play, gain 1 lore.
SUIT UP {E}, 2 {I} — If you played a Hero character this turn, draw a card.

text.title: SIMPLE, ELEGANT
text.description: When you play this item, if you have a Hero character in play, gain 1 lore.

text.title: SUIT UP
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — If you played a Hero character this turn, draw a card.

text.title: Schlicht und elegant
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, falls du mindestens einen Helden im Spiel hast, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: Ankleiden
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Falls du in diesem Zug mindestens einen Helden ausgespielt hast, ziehe 1 Karte.

text.title: Simple, élégant
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, si vous avez un personnage Héros en jeu, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Enfiler son costume
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Si vous avez joué un personnage Héros ce tour-ci, piochez une carte.

text.title: Semplice, Elegante
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, se hai in gioco un personaggio Eroe, ottieni 1 leggenda.

text.title: Prepararsi
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Se hai giocato un personaggio Eroe in questo turno, pesca una carta.

set12-067.name: DunBroch Family Tapestry
set12-067.rulesText:
TORN APART This item enters play exerted.
MEND THE BOND {E}, Banish this item — Each player shuffles all character cards from their discard into their deck.

text.title: TORN APART
text.description: This item enters play exerted.

text.title: MEND THE BOND
text.description: {E}, Banish this item — Each player shuffles all character cards from their discard into their deck.

text.title: Zerrissen
text.description: Dieser Gegenstand kommt erschöpft ins Spiel.

text.title: Das Band wiederherstellen
text.description: {E}, Verbanne diesen Gegenstand — Alle Mitspielenden mischen alle Charakterkarten aus ihrem Ablagestapel zurück in ihr Deck.

text.title: Déchirée
text.description: Cet objet entre en jeu épuisé.

text.title: Répare le mal

set12-098.name: Buzz's Arm
set12-098.rulesText:

set12-099.name: The Claw
set12-099.rulesText: THE CLAW CHOOSES {E}, 2 {I}, Banish one of your characters — Return chosen opposing character to their player's hand.

text.title: THE CLAW CHOOSES
text.description: {E}, 2 {I}, Banish one of your characters — Return chosen opposing character to their player's hand.

text.title: Die Kralle bestimmt

text.title: L'Artiglio Sceglie
text.description: {E}, 2 {I}, esilia uno dei tuoi personaggi — Fai riprendere in mano al suo giocatore un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set12-100.name: Gyro-Evac
set12-100.rulesText:

text.title: Atterraggio di Fortuna

set12-101.name: Merida's Bow
set12-101.rulesText:

text.title: FINAL ARROW 1

text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Regardez les 4 cartes du dessus de votre pioche. Vous pouvez révéler une carte Lieu parmi elles et l'ajouter à votre main. Placez les autres cartes sous votre pioche, dans l'ordre de votre choix.

set12-166.name: Julieta's Arepas
set12-166.rulesText:

text.title: Remède savoureux
text.description: Au début de votre tour, si vous avez un personnage Madrigal en jeu, choisissez un personnage et retirez jusqu'à 2 de ses dommages.

text.title: Ça a fait l'affaire

text.description: All'inizio del tuo turno, se hai in gioco un personaggio Madrigal, rimuovi fino a 2 danni da un personaggio a tua scelta.

set12-167.name: Ranger Plane
set12-167.rulesText:

text.title: Supporto Aereo

text.title: Carico Pesante
text.description: {E} — Un personaggio a tua scelta con 10 {S} o superiore riceve +3 {L} per questo turno.

set12-168.name: Gadget's Goggles
set12-168.rulesText: ENHANCED VISION {E}, 1 {I} — Look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one on the top of your deck and the other on the bottom.

text.description: Ogni volta che un personaggio Robot viene esiliato, puoi esiliare questo oggetto per scartare la tua mano e pescare 2 carte.

Falls sie eine Charakterkarte ist, die 3 oder weniger kostet, oder falls sie eine Pocahontas-Charakterkarte ist, darfst du sie auf deine Hand nehmen. Falls nicht, lege sie unter dein Deck.

text.description: À la fin de votre tour, si l'un de vos personnages a défié ce tour-ci, bannissez cet objet.

text.description: À la fin de votre tour, si aucun de vos personnages n'a défié ce tour-ci, révélez la carte du dessus de votre pioche. S'il s'agit d'une carte Personnage coûtant 3 ou moins ou qu'elle est nommée Pocahontas, vous pouvez l'ajouter à votre main. Sinon, placez-la sous votre pioche.

set11-168.name: Darkwing's Chair Set
set11-168.rulesText:

text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Metti 1 segnalino danno su un personaggio a tua scelta.

text.title: Rabbia Incontrollata
text.description: {E}, esilia questo oggetto — Ogni personaggio avversario danneggiato ottiene <Attaccabrighe> fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno. (Non può andare all'avventura e deve sfidare, se possibile.)

set10-099.name: Inscrutable Map
set10-099.rulesText: BACKTRACK {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen opposing character gets -1 {L} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: BACKTRACK
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen opposing character gets -1 {L} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Zurückverfolgen
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Ein gegnerischer Charakter deiner Wahl erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges -1 {L}.

text.title: Rebrousser chemin
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Choisissez un personnage adverse qui subit -1 {L} jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Tornare sui Propri Passi
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Un personaggio avversario a tua scelta riceve -1 {L} fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

set10-100.name: Enigmatic Inkcaster
set10-100.rulesText: ITS OWN REWARD {E} — If you've played 2 or more cards this turn, gain 1 lore.

text.title: ITS OWN REWARD
text.description: {E} — If you've played 2 or more cards this turn, gain 1 lore.

text.title: Seine eigene Belohnung
text.description: {E} — Falls du in diesem Zug mindestens 2 Karten ausgespielt hast, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: Une récompense en soi
text.description: {E} — Si vous avez joué 2 cartes ou plus ce tour-ci, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Una Ricompensa di Per Sé
text.description: {E} — Se hai giocato 2 o più carte in questo turno, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set10-101.name: Blessed Bagpipes
set10-101.rulesText:
MCDUCK HEIRLOOM When you play this item, you may put the top card of your deck facedown under one of your characters or locations with Boost.
BATTLE ANTHEM Whenever one of your characters or locations with a card under them is challenged, gain 1 lore.

text.title: MCDUCK HEIRLOOM
text.description: When you play this item, you may put the top card of your deck facedown under one of your characters or locations with Boost.

text.title: BATTLE ANTHEM
text.description: Whenever one of your characters or locations with a card under them is challenged, gain 1 lore.

text.title: Duck-Erbstück
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, darfst du die oberste Karte deines Decks verdeckt unter einen deiner Charaktere oder Orte mit <Stärken> legen.

text.title: Schlachthymne
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn einer deiner Charaktere oder Orte, der eine Karte unter sich hat, herausgefordert wird, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: Héritage des Mac Picsou
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, vous pouvez placer la carte du dessus de votre pioche sous l'un de vos personnages ou de vos lieux ayant <Boost>.

text.title: Musique de bataille
text.description: Chaque fois que l'un de vos personnages ou de vos lieux avec une carte sous lui est défié, vous gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Cimelio de' Paperoni
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, puoi mettere la prima carta del tuo mazzo a faccia in giù sotto a uno dei tuoi personaggi o luoghi con <Potenziamento>.

text.title: Marcia da Guerra
text.description: Ogni volta che uno dei tuoi personaggi o luoghi con una carta sotto di sé viene sfidato, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set10-134.name: Mushu's Rocket
set10-134.rulesText:
I NEED FIREPOWER When you play this item, chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
HITCH A RIDE 2 {I}, Banish this item — Chosen character gains Rush this turn.

text.title: I NEED FIREPOWER
text.description: When you play this item, chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

text.title: HITCH A RIDE 2
text.description: {I}, Banish this item — Chosen character gains Rush this turn.

text.title: Könnt ihr mir mal Feuer geben?
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, erhält ein Charakter deiner Wahl in diesem Zug <Rasant>. (Der Charakter kann im selben Zug herausfordern, in dem er ausgespielt wird.)

text.title: Mitfahren
text.description: 2 {I}, Verbanne diesen Gegenstand — Ein Charakter deiner Wahl erhält in diesem Zug <Rasant>.

text.title: Vous n'auriez pas du feu?
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, choisissez un personnage qui gagne <Charge> pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Monture de fortune
text.description: 2 {I}, Bannissez cet objet — Choisissez un personnage qui gagne <Charge> pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Voglio la Potenza del Fuoco
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Lesto> per questo turno. (Può sfidare nel turno in cui viene giocato.)

text.title: Scroccare un Passaggio
text.description: 2 {I}, esilia questo oggetto — Un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Lesto> per questo turno.

set10-166.name: Detective's Badge
set10-166.rulesText: PROTECT AND SERVE {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains Resist +1 and the Detective classification until the start of your next turn.

text.title: PROTECT AND SERVE
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains Resist +1 and the Detective classification until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Schützen und dienen
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Ein Charakter deiner Wahl erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Robust> +1 und die Klassifizierung Detektiv. (Reduziere jeglichen Schaden, der dem Charakter zugefügt wird, um 1.)

text.title: Protéger et servir
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Choisissez un personnage qui gagne <Résistance> +1 et la classification Détective jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Proteggere e Servire
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Resistere> +1 e la classificazione Detective fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

set10-167.name: Ink Amplifier
set10-167.rulesText: ENERGY CAPTURE Whenever an opponent draws a card during their turn, if it's the second card they've drawn this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: ENERGY CAPTURE
text.description: Whenever an opponent draws a card during their turn, if it's the second card they've drawn this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: Energiegewinnung
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn eine gegnerische Person in ihrem Zug 1 Karte zieht und falls es die zweite Karte ist, die sie in diesem Zug zieht, darfst du die oberste Karte deines Decks verdeckt und erschöpft in deinen Tintenvorrat legen.

text.title: Capture d'énergie
text.description: Chaque fois qu'un adversaire pioche une carte durant son tour, si c'est la deuxième qu'il pioche ce tour-ci, vous pouvez placer la carte du dessus de votre pioche dans votre réserve d'encre, face cachée et épuisée.

text.title: Catturare Energia
text.description: Ogni volta che un avversario pesca una carta durante il suo turno, se è la seconda carta che ha pescato in questo turno, puoi aggiungere la prima carta del tuo mazzo al tuo calamaio, a faccia in giù e impegnata.

set10-168.name: Fairy Godmother's Wand
set10-168.rulesText: ONLY TILL MIDNIGHT During your turn, whenever you put a card into your inkwell, chosen Princess character of yours gains Ward until the start of your next turn.

text.title: ONLY TILL MIDNIGHT
text.description: During your turn, whenever you put a card into your inkwell, chosen Princess character of yours gains Ward until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Nur bis Mitternacht
text.description: Jedes Mal während deines Zuges, wenn eine Karte in deinen Tintenvorrat gelegt wird, wähle eine deiner Prinzessinnen. Sie erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Behütet>. (Gegnerische Mitspielende können die Prinzessin nicht auswählen, außer um sie herauszufordern.)

text.title: Dès que minuit sonnera
text.description: Durant votre tour, chaque fois que vous placez une carte dans votre réserve d'encre, choisissez l'un de vos personnages Princesse qui gagne <Hors d'atteinte> jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour. (Les adversaires ne peuvent pas choisir ces personnages, hormis pour un défi.)

text.title: Solo Fino a Mezzanotte
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che aggiungi una carta al tuo calamaio, un tuo personaggio Principessa a tua scelta ottiene <Protetto> fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno. (Gli avversari non possono sceglierlo se non per sfidarlo.)

set10-169.name: Inkrunner
set10-169.rulesText:
PREFLIGHT CHECK When you play this item, draw a card.
READY TO RIDE {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains Alert this turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)

text.title: PREFLIGHT CHECK
text.description: When you play this item, draw a card.

text.title: READY TO RIDE
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains Alert this turn. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)

text.title: Kontrolle vor dem Flug
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, ziehe 1 Karte.

text.title: Bereit zum Abflug
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Ein Charakter deiner Wahl erhält in diesem Zug <Alarmiert>. (Der Charakter kann herausfordern, als hätte er Wendig.)

text.title: Préparatifs de vol
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, piochez une carte.

text.title: Paré à voler
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Choisissez un personnage qui gagne <Agilité> pour le reste de ce tour. (Il peut défier comme s'il avait Insaisissable.)

text.title: Verifica Pre-Volo
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, pesca una carta.

text.title: Pronto a Partire
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Vigile> per questo turno. (Può sfidare come se avesse Sfuggente.)

set10-199.name: The Robot Queen
set10-199.rulesText: MAJOR MALFUNCTION Whenever you play a character, you may pay 1 {I} and banish this item to deal 2 damage to chosen character.

text.title: MAJOR MALFUNCTION
text.description: Whenever you play a character, you may pay 1 {I} and banish this item to deal 2 damage to chosen character.

text.title: Letzter Akt
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du einen Charakter ausspielst, darfst du 1 {I} bezahlen und diesen Gegenstand verbannen, um einem Charakter deiner Wahl 2 Schaden zuzufügen.

text.title: Dysfonctionnement majeur
text.description: Chaque fois que vous jouez un personnage, vous pouvez payer 1 {I} et bannir cet objet pour choisir un personnage et lui infliger 2 dommages.

text.title: Grave Malfunzionamento
text.description: Ogni volta che giochi un personaggio, puoi pagare 1 {I} ed esiliare questo oggetto per infliggere 2 danni a un personaggio a tua scelta.

set10-200.name: The Sword of Hercules
set10-200.rulesText:
MIGHTY HIT When you play this item, banish chosen opposing Deity character.
HAND-TO-HAND During your turn, whenever one of your characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 1 lore.

text.title: MIGHTY HIT
text.description: When you play this item, banish chosen opposing Deity character.

text.title: HAND-TO-HAND
text.description: During your turn, whenever one of your characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 1 lore.

text.title: Mächtiger Treffer
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, verbanne eine gegnerische Gottheit deiner Wahl.

text.title: Mann gegen Mann
text.description: Jedes Mal während deines Zuges, wenn einer deiner Charaktere durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: Coup puissant
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, choisissez un personnage Dieu adverse et bannissez-le.

text.title: Corps-à-corps
text.description: Durant votre tour, chaque fois que l'un de vos personnages en bannit un autre via un défi, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Colpo Potente
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, esilia un personaggio Divinità avversario a tua scelta.

text.title: Corpo a Corpo
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che uno dei tuoi personaggi esilia un altro personaggio in una sfida, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set10-201.name: Ingenious Device
set10-201.rulesText:
SURPRISE PACKAGE {E}, 2 {I}, Banish this item — Draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
TIME GROWS SHORT During your turn, when this item is banished, deal 3 damage to chosen character or location.

text.title: SURPRISE PACKAGE
text.description: {E}, 2 {I}, Banish this item — Draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

text.title: TIME GROWS SHORT
text.description: During your turn, when this item is banished, deal 3 damage to chosen character or location.

text.title: Überraschung
text.description: {E}, 2 {I}, Verbanne diesen Gegenstand — Ziehe 1 Karte. Wähle danach 1 Karte aus deiner Hand und wirf sie ab.

text.title: Die Zeit wird knapp
text.description: Wenn dieser Gegenstand in deinem Zug verbannt wird, füge einem Charakter oder Ort deiner Wahl 3 Schaden zu.

text.title: Un genre de paquet surprise
text.description: {E}, 2 {I}, Bannissez cet objet — Piochez une carte puis défaussez-en une.

text.title: Comme le temps passe
text.description: Durant votre tour, lorsque cet objet est banni, choisissez un personnage ou un lieu et infligez-lui 3 dommages.

text.title: Souvenir
text.description: {E}, 2 {I}, esilia questo oggetto — Pesca una carta, poi scegli e scarta una carta.

text.title: Il Tempo Vola
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, quando questo oggetto viene esiliato, infliggi 3 danni a un personaggio o a un luogo a tua scelta.

set10-225-enchanted.name: The Black Cauldron
set10-225-enchanted.rulesText:
THE CAULDRON CALLS {E}, 1 {I} — Put a character card from your discard under this item faceup.
RISE AND JOIN ME! {E}, 1 {I} — This turn, you may play characters from under this item.

text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Put a character card from your discard under this item faceup.

text.title: RISE AND JOIN ME!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — This turn, you may play characters from under this item.

text.title: Der Kessel ruft
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Lege 1 Charakterkarte aus deinem Ablagestapel offen unter diesen Gegenstand.

text.title: Steht auf und folgt mir!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Du darfst in diesem Zug Charaktere ausspielen, die unter diesem Gegenstand liegen.

text.title: L'Appel du chaudron
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Placez une carte Personnage de votre défausse sous cet objet, face visible.

text.title: Levez-vous et joignez-vous à moi!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Pour le reste de ce tour, vous pouvez jouer les personnages placés sous cet objet.

text.title: Il Richiamo della Pentola
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Metti una carta personaggio dai tuoi scarti sotto a questo oggetto, a faccia in su.

text.title: Alzatevi e Unitevi a Me!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Per questo turno, puoi giocare i personaggi da sotto questo oggetto.

set10-240-enchanted.name: The Sword of Hercules

MIGHTY HIT When you play this item, banish chosen opposing Deity character.
HAND-TO-HAND During your turn, whenever one of your characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 1 lore.

text.title: Mächtiger Treffer
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, verbanne eine gegnerische Gottheit deiner Wahl.

text.title: Mann gegen Mann
text.description: Jedes Mal während deines Zuges, wenn einer deiner Charaktere durch eine Herausforderung einen anderen Charakter verbannt, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, choisissez un personnage Dieu adverse et bannissez-le.

text.description: Durant votre tour, chaque fois que l'un de vos personnages en bannit un autre via un défi, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Colpo Potente
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, esilia un personaggio Divinità avversario a tua scelta.

text.title: Corpo a Corpo
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che uno dei tuoi personaggi esilia un altro personaggio in una sfida, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set9-032.name: Lantern
set9-032.rulesText: BIRTHDAY LIGHTS {E} — You pay 1 {I} less for the next character you play this turn.

text.title: BIRTHDAY LIGHTS
text.description: {E} — You pay 1 {I} less for the next character you play this turn.

text.title: Geburtstagslichter
text.description: {E} — Du zahlst 1 {I} weniger für den nächsten Charakter, den du in diesem Zug ausspielst.

text.title: LUMIÈRES D'ANNIVERSAIRE
text.description: {E} — Le prochain personnage que vous jouez durant ce tour coûte 1 {I} de moins.

text.title: Luci di Compleanno
text.description: {E} — Paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare il tuo prossimo personaggio per questo turno.

set9-033.name: Ursula’s Shell Necklace
set9-033.rulesText: \Now, Sing!\ Whenever you play a song, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card.

text.title: Now, Sing!
text.description: Whenever you play a song, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card.

text.title: Und jetzt Sing!
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du ein Lied ausspielst, darfst du 1 {I} zahlen, um 1 Karte zu ziehen.

text.title: MAINTENANT, CHANTE!
text.description: Chaque fois que vous jouez une chanson, vous pouvez payer 1 {I} pour piocher une carte.

text.title: Now, Sing!
text.description: Whenever you play a song, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card.

set9-064.name: The Magic Feather
set9-064.rulesText:
NOW YOU CAN FLY! When you play this item, choose a character of yours. While this item is in play, that character gains Evasive.
GROUNDED 3 {I} — Return this item to your hand.

text.title: NOW YOU CAN FLY!
text.description: When you play this item, choose a character of yours. While this item is in play, that character gains Evasive.

text.title: GROUNDED 3
text.description: {I} — Return this item to your hand.

text.title: Jetzt kannst du fliegen!
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, wähle einen deiner Charaktere. Solange dieser Gegenstand im Spiel ist, erhält jener Charakter <Wendig>.

text.title: Geerdet
text.description: 3 {I} — Nimm diesen Gegenstand zurück auf deine Hand.

text.title: Tu vas pouvoir voler!
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, choisissez l'un de vos personnages. Tant que cet objet est en jeu, le personnage ainsi choisi gagne <Insaisissable>.

text.title: Au sol
text.description: 3 {I} — Renvoyez cet objet dans votre main.

text.title: Ora Potrai Volare!
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, scegli un tuo personaggio. Mentre questo oggetto è in gioco, quel personaggio ottiene <Sfuggente>. (Solo altri personaggi con Sfuggente possono sfidarlo.)

text.title: A Terra
text.description: 3 {I} — Riprendi in mano questo oggetto.

text.title: SPEAK!
text.description: {E}, 4 {I} — Draw a card.

text.title: Sprich!
text.description: {E}, 4 {I} — Ziehe 1 Karte.

text.title: PARLE!
text.description: {E}, 4 {I} — Piochez une carte.

text.title: Speak!
text.description: {E}, 4 {I} — Draw a card.

set9-066.name: White Rabbit’s Pocket Watch
set9-066.rulesText: \I'm Late!\ {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains <Rush> this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

text.title: I'm Late!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains <Rush> this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

text.title: Zu spät!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Ein Charakter deiner Wahl erhält in diesem Zug Rasant. (Der Charakter kann im selben Zug herausfordern, in dem er ausgespielt wird.)

text.title: EN RETARD!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Choisissez un personnage, il gagne Charge pour le reste de ce tour. (Il peut défier le tour où il est joué.)

text.title: I'm Late!
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains <Rush> this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)

set9-067.name: Rose Lantern
set9-067.rulesText: MYSTICAL PETALS {E}, 2 {I} — Move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: MYSTICAL PETALS
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Geheimnisvolle Blütenblätter
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Verschiebe 1 Schadensmarker von einem Charakter deiner Wahl zu einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl.

text.title: Pétales mystiques
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Choisissez un personnage et déplacez 1 de ses jetons Dommage sur un personnage adverse de votre choix.

text.title: Petali Mistici
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Sposta 1 segnalino danno da un personaggio a tua scelta a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set9-100.name: Family Fishing Pole
set9-100.rulesText:
WATCH CLOSELY This item enters play exerted.
THE PERFECT CAST {E}, 1 {I}, Banish this item — Return chosen exerted character of yours to your hand to gain 2 lore.

text.title: WATCH CLOSELY
text.description: This item enters play exerted.

text.title: THE PERFECT CAST
text.description: {E}, 1 {I}, Banish this item — Return chosen exerted character of yours to your hand to gain 2 lore.

text.title: Pass gut auf
text.description: Dieser Gegenstand kommt erschöpft ins Spiel.

text.title: Der perfekte Wurf
text.description: {E}, 1 {I}, Verbanne diesen Gegenstand — Wähle einen deiner erschöpften Charaktere und nimm ihn zurück auf deine Hand, um 2 Legenden zu sammeln.

text.title: Observe attentivement
text.description: Cet objet arrive en jeu épuisé.

text.title: Le parfait lancer
text.description: {E}, 1 {I}, bannissez cet objet — Choisissez l'un de vos personnages épuisés et renvoyez-le dans votre main pour gagner 2 éclats de Lore.

text.title: Osserva Attentamente
text.description: Questo oggetto entra in gioco impegnato.

text.title: La Tecnica del Grande Lancio
text.description: {E}, 1 {I}, esilia questo oggetto — Riprendi in mano un tuo personaggio impegnato a tua scelta per ottenere 2 leggenda.

set9-101.name: Signed Contract
set9-101.rulesText: FINE PRINT Whenever an opponent plays a song, you may draw a card.

text.title: FINE PRINT
text.description: Whenever an opponent plays a song, you may draw a card.

text.title: Kleingedrucktes
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn eine gegnerische Person ein Lied spielt, darfst du 1 Karte ziehen.

text.title: Petits caractères
text.description: Chaque fois qu'un adversaire joue une chanson, vous pouvez piocher une carte.

text.title: Clausole in Piccolo
text.description: Ogni volta che un avversario gioca una canzone, puoi pescare una carta.

set9-134.name: Medallion Weights
set9-134.rulesText: DISCIPLINE AND STRENGTH {E}, 2 {I} — Chosen character gets +2 {S} this turn. Whenever they challenge another character this turn, you may draw a card.

text.title: DISCIPLINE AND STRENGTH
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Chosen character gets +2 {S} this turn. Whenever they challenge another character this turn, you may draw a card.

text.title: Disziplin und Stärke
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Gib einem Charakter deiner Wahl in diesem Zug +2 {S}. Jedes Mal, wenn er in diesem Zug einen anderen Charakter herausfordert, darfst du 1 Karte ziehen.

text.title: Discipline et Force
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Choisissez un personnage qui gagne +2 {S} pour le reste de ce tour. Chaque fois qu'il défie un autre personnage durant ce tour, vous pouvez piocher une carte.

text.title: Disciplina e Forza
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Un personaggio a tua scelta riceve +2 {S} per questo turno. Ogni volta che sfida un altro personaggio per questo turno, puoi pescare una carta.

set9-135.name: Dinner Bell
set9-135.rulesText: YOU KNOW WHAT HAPPENS {E}, 2 {I} — Draw cards equal to the damage on chosen character of yours, then banish them.

text.title: YOU KNOW WHAT HAPPENS
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Draw cards equal to the damage on chosen character of yours, then banish them.

text.title: Du weißt, was passiert
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Wähle einen deiner Charaktere und zähle den Schaden auf ihm. Ziehe diese Anzahl an Karten und verbanne den Charakter anschließend.

text.title: Tu sais ce qui se passe
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Choisissez l'un de vos personnages blessés et piochez une carte pour chaque jeton Dommage sur lui, puis bannissez-le.

text.title: You Know What Happens
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Draw cards equal to the damage on chosen character of yours, then banish them.

set9-167.name: Aurelian Gyrosensor
set9-167.rulesText: SEEKING KNOWLEDGE Whenever one of your characters quests, you may look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

text.title: SEEKING KNOWLEDGE
text.description: Whenever one of your characters quests, you may look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

text.title: Suche nach Wissen
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn einer deiner Charaktere erkundet, darfst du dir die oberste Karte deines Decks anschauen. Lege sie anschließend entweder auf dein Deck oder darunter.

text.title: À la recherche du savoir
text.description: Chaque fois que vous envoyez l'un de vos personnages à l'aventure, vous pouvez regarder la première carte de votre pioche. Remettez-la soit sur le dessus de votre pioche, soit en dessous.

text.title: In Cerca di Conoscenza
text.description: Ogni volta che uno dei tuoi personaggi va all'avventura, puoi guardare la prima carta del tuo mazzo. Mettila o in cima o in fondo al tuo mazzo.

set9-168.name: Heart of Te Fiti
set9-168.rulesText: CREATE LIFE {E}, 2 {I} — Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: CREATE LIFE
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: Leben erschaffen
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Lege die oberste Karte deines Decks verdeckt und erschöpft in deinen Tintenvorrat.

text.title: Engendrer la vie
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Placez la première carte de votre pioche dans votre réserve d'encre, face cachée et épuisée.

text.title: Creare la Vita
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Aggiungi la prima carta del tuo mazzo al tuo calamaio, a faccia in giù e impegnata.

set9-169.name: Coconut Basket
set9-169.rulesText: CONSIDER THE COCONUT Whenever you play a character, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

text.title: CONSIDER THE COCONUT
text.description: Whenever you play a character, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

text.title: Denk nur an die Kokosnuss
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du einen Charakter ausspielst, darfst du bis zu 2 Schaden von einem Charakter deiner Wahl entfernen.

text.title: NOUS AVONS LA NOIX DE COCO
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez un personnage, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et lui retirer jusqu'à 2 jetons Dommage.

text.title: Consider the Coconut
text.description: Whenever you play a character, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

set9-203.name: Beast’s Mirror
set9-203.rulesText: \Show Me\ {E}, 3 {I} — If you have no cards in your hand, draw a card.

text.title: Show Me
text.description: {E}, 3 {I} — If you have no cards in your hand, draw a card.

text.title: Zeig's mir
text.description: {E}, 3 {I} — Wenn du keine Karten auf der Hand hast, ziehe 1 Karte.

text.title: MONTRE-MOI
text.description: {E}, 3 {I} — Si vous n'avez plus de carte en main, piochez une carte.

text.title: Show Me
text.description: {E}, 3 {I} — If you have no cards in your hand, draw a card.

set8-044.name: The Nephews' Piggy Bank
set8-044.rulesText:
INSIDE JOB If you have a character named Donald Duck in play, you pay 1 {I} less to play this item.
PAYOFF {E} — Chosen character gets -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: INSIDE JOB
text.description: If you have a character named Donald Duck in play, you pay 1 {I} less to play this item.

text.title: PAYOFF
text.description: {E} — Chosen character gets -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Insider-Job
text.description: Wenn du einen Donald-Duck-Charakter im Spiel hast, zahlst du 1 {I} weniger, um diesen Gegenstand auszuspielen.

text.title: Rückzahlung
text.description: {E} — Gib einem Charakter deiner Wahl bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges -1 {S}.

text.title: Combine
text.description: Jouer cet objet vous coûte 1 {I} de moins si vous avez un personnage Donald en jeu.

text.title: Récompense
text.description: {E} — Choisissez un personnage qui subit -1 {S} jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Infiltrato
text.description: Se hai in gioco un personaggio chiamato Paperino, paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare questo oggetto.

text.title: Ricompensa
text.description: {E} — Un personaggio a tua scelta riceve -1 {S} fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

set8-083.name: Scarab
set8-083.rulesText: SEARCH THE SANDS {E} 2 {I} — Return an Illusion character card from your discard to your hand.

text.title: SEARCH THE SANDS
text.description: {E} 2 {I} — Return an Illusion character card from your discard to your hand.

text.title: Durchsucht den Sand
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Nimm eine Illusions-Charakterkarte aus deinem Ablagestapel zurück auf deine Hand.

text.title: Fouiller le sable
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Renvoyez une carte Personnage Illusion de votre défausse dans votre main.

text.title: Cercate tra le Sabbie
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Riprendi in mano una carta personaggio Illusione dai tuoi scarti.

set8-084.name: Ice Spikes
set8-084.rulesText:
HOLD STILL When you play this item, exert chosen opposing character.
IT'S STUCK {E}, 1 {I} — Exert chosen opposing item. It can't ready at the start of its next turn.

text.title: HOLD STILL
text.description: When you play this item, exert chosen opposing character.

text.title: IT'S STUCK
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Exert chosen opposing item. It can't ready at the start of its next turn.

text.title: Halt still
text.description: Wenn du diesen Gegenstand ausspielst, erschöpfe einen gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl.

text.title: Es klemmt
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Erschöpfe einen gegnerischen Gegenstand deiner Wahl. Er wird zu Beginn seines nächsten Zuges nicht bereit gemacht.

text.title: Ne bougez plus
text.description: Lorsque vous jouez cet objet, choisissez un personnage adverse et épuisez-le.

text.title: C'est coincé
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Choisissez un objet adverse et épuisez-le. Il ne se redresse pas au début du prochain tour de son propriétaire.

text.title: Stai Fermo
text.description: Quando giochi questo oggetto, impegna un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

text.title: È Bloccato
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Impegna un oggetto avversario a tua scelta. Non si può preparare all'inizio del suo prossimo turno.

set8-119.name: Chem Purse
set8-119.rulesText: HERE'S THE BEST PART Whenever you play a character, if you used Shift to play them, they get +4 {S} this turn.

text.title: HERE'S THE BEST PART
text.description: Whenever you play a character, if you used Shift to play them, they get +4 {S} this turn.

text.title: Jetzt kommt das Beste
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du mithilfe von <Gestaltwandel> eine Flutgestalt ausspielst, erhält jene in diesem Zug +4 {S}.

text.title: Et t'as encore rien vu
text.description: Chaque fois que vous jouez un personnage en utilisant sa capacité <Alter>, il gagne +4 {S} pour le reste du tour.

text.title: Ora Arriva il Meglio
text.description: Ogni volta che giochi un personaggio, se hai usato <Trasformazione> per giocarlo, riceve +4 {S} per questo turno.

set8-120.name: Jeweled Collar
set8-120.rulesText: WELCOME EXTRAVAGANCE Whenever one of your characters is challenged, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: WELCOME EXTRAVAGANCE
text.description: Whenever one of your characters is challenged, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: Willkommen Extravaganz
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn einer deiner Charaktere herausgefordert wird, darfst du die oberste Karte deines Decks verdeckt und erschöpft in deinen Tintenvorrat legen.

text.title: Extravagant et de bon goût
text.description: Chaque fois que l'un de vos personnages est défié, vous pouvez placer la carte du dessus de votre pioche dans votre réserve d'encre, face cachée et épuisée.

text.title: Benvenuta Stravaganza
text.description: Ogni volta che uno dei tuoi personaggi viene sfidato, puoi aggiungere la prima carta del tuo mazzo al tuo calamaio, a faccia in giù e impegnata.

set8-152.name: The Sword of Shan-Yu
set8-152.rulesText: WORTHY WEAPON {E}, {E} one of your characters — Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

text.title: WORTHY WEAPON
text.description: {E}, {E} one of your characters — Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

text.title: Würdige Waffe
text.description: {E}, {E} einen deiner Charaktere — Mache einen Charakter deiner Wahl bereit. Er kann in diesem Zug nicht mehr erkunden.

text.title: Une arme digne de ce nom
text.description: {E}, {E} l'un de vos personnages — Choisissez un personnage et redressez-le. Ce personnage ne peut pas être envoyé à l'aventure pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Arma Degna
text.description: {E}, {E} uno dei tuoi personaggi — Prepara un personaggio a tua scelta. Non può andare all'avventura per il resto di questo turno.

set8-178.name: Television Set
set8-178.rulesText: IS IT ON YET? {E}, 1 {I} — Look at the top card of your deck. If it's a Puppy character card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: IS IT ON YET?
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Look at the top card of your deck. If it's a Puppy character card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

text.title: Läuft sie schon?
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Schaue dir die oberste Karte deines Decks an. Falls sie eine Welpen-Charakterkarte ist, darfst du sie aufdecken und auf deine Hand nehmen. Falls nicht, lege sie unter dein Deck.

text.title: Ça a commencé?
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Regardez la carte du dessus de votre pioche. S'il s'agit d'une carte Personnage Chiot, vous pouvez la révéler et la prendre en main. Sinon, placez-la sous votre pioche.

text.title: È Già Iniziato?
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Guarda la prima carta del tuo mazzo. Se è una carta personaggio Cucciolo, puoi rivelarla e aggiungerla alla tua mano. Altrimenti, mettila in fondo al tuo mazzo.

set8-179.name: Belle's Favorite Book
set8-179.rulesText: CHAPTER THREE {E}, Banish one of your other items — Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: CHAPTER THREE
text.description: {E}, Banish one of your other items — Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

text.title: Kapitel drei
text.description: {E}, Verbanne einen deiner anderen Gegenstände — Lege die oberste Karte deines Decks verdeckt und erschöpft in deinen Tintenvorrat.

text.title: Chapitre trois
text.description: {E}, Bannissez un autre de vos objets — Placez la carte du dessus de votre pioche dans votre réserve d'encre, face cachée et épuisée.

text.title: Capitolo Tre
text.description: {E}, esilia uno dei tuoi altri oggetti — Aggiungi la prima carta del tuo mazzo al tuo calamaio, a faccia in giù e impegnata.

set8-180.name: Atlantean Crystal
set8-180.rulesText: SHIELDING LIGHT {E}, 2 {I} — Chosen character gains Resist +2 and Support until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2. Whenever they quest, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)

text.title: SHIELDING LIGHT
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Chosen character gains Resist +2 and Support until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2. Whenever they quest, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)

text.title: Schützendes Licht
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Ein Charakter deiner Wahl erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Robust> +2 und <Unterstützen>. (Reduziere jeglichen Schaden, der dem Charakter zugefügt wird, um 2. Jedes Mal, wenn der Charakter erkundet, darfst du seine {S} in diesem Zug zur {S} eines anderen Charakters deiner Wahl addieren.)

text.title: Lumière protectrice
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Choisissez un personnage qui gagne <Résistance> +2 et <Soutien> jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour. (Les dommages qui lui sont infligés sont réduits de 2. Chaque fois que ce personnage est envoyé à l'aventure, vous pouvez ajouter sa {S} à celle d'un autre personnage au choix pour le reste de ce tour.)

text.title: Luce Protettiva
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Resistere> +2 e <Aiutante> fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno. (Il danno che gli viene inflitto è ridotto di 2. Ogni volta che va all'avventura, puoi aggiungere la sua {S} alla {S} di un altro personaggio a tua scelta per questo turno.)

set8-204.name: Hamster Ball
set8-204.rulesText: ROLL WITH THE PUNCHES {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character with no damage gains Resist +2 until the start of your next turn.

text.title: ROLL WITH THE PUNCHES
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character with no damage gains Resist +2 until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Fängt jeden Schlag ab
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Ein unbeschädigter Charakter deiner Wahl erhält bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Robust> +2. (Reduziere jeglichen Schaden, der dem Charakter zugefügt wird, um 2.)

text.title: Faire face aux coups
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Choisissez un personnage sans dommage sur lui. Il gagne <Résistance> +2 jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Resistenza Sferica
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Un personaggio a tua scelta senza danno ottiene <Resistere> +2 fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno.

set8-219-enchanted.name: The Sword of Shan-Yu
set8-219-enchanted.rulesText: WORTHY WEAPON {E}, {E} one of your characters — Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

text.title: WORTHY WEAPON
text.description: {E}, {E} one of your characters — Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

text.title: Würdige Waffe
text.description: {E}, {E} einen deiner Charaktere — Mache einen Charakter deiner Wahl bereit. Er kann in diesem Zug nicht mehr erkunden.

text.title: Une arme digne de ce nom
text.description: {E}, {E} l'un de vos personnages — Choisissez un personnage et redressez-le. Ce personnage ne peut pas être envoyé à l'aventure pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Arma Degna
text.description: {E}, {E} uno dei tuoi personaggi — Prepara un personaggio a tua scelta. Non può andare all'avventura per il resto di questo turno.

set7-041.name: Amber Coil
set7-041.rulesText: HEALING AURA During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

text.title: HEALING AURA
text.description: During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may remove up to 2 damage from chosen character.

text.title: Heilende Aura
text.description: Jedes Mal während deines Zuges, wenn eine Karte in deinen Tintenvorrat gelegt wird, darfst du bis zu 2 Schaden von einem Charakter deiner Wahl entfernen.

text.title: Aura guérisseuse
text.description: Durant votre tour, chaque fois qu'une carte est placée dans votre réserve d'encre, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et lui retirer jusqu'à 2 dommages.

text.title: Aura Curativa
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che una carta viene aggiunta al tuo calamaio, puoi rimuovere fino a 2 danni da un personaggio a tua scelta.

set7-042.name: Spaghetti Dinner
set7-042.rulesText: FINE DINING {E}, 1 {I} — If you have 2 or more characters in play, gain 1 lore.

text.title: FINE DINING
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — If you have 2 or more characters in play, gain 1 lore.

text.title: Gehobene Küche
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Wenn du mindestens 2 Charaktere im Spiel hast, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: Cuisine raffinée
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Si vous avez au moins 2 personnages en jeu, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Cucina Raffinata
text.description: {E}, 1 {I} — Se hai in gioco 2 o più personaggi, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set7-043.name: Kanine Krunchies
set7-043.rulesText: YOU CAN BE A CHAMPION, TOO Your Puppy characters get +1 {W}.

text.title: YOU CAN BE
text.description: A CHAMPION, TOO Your Puppy characters get +1 {W}.

text.title: Kräcker für die kleinen Hunde
text.description: Deine Welpen erhalten +1 {W}.

text.title: À pleines dents
text.description: Vos personnages Chiot gagnent +1 {W}.

text.title: Se lo tratti con amore
text.description: I tuoi personaggi Cucciolo ricevono +1 {W}.

set7-044.name: The Glass Slipper
set7-044.rulesText:
PERFECT PAIR You may only have 2 copies of The Glass Slipper in your deck.
SEARCH THE KINGDOM Banish this item, {E} one of your Prince characters — Search your deck for a Princess character card and reveal it to all players. Put that card into your hand and shuffle your deck.

text.title: PERFECT PAIR
text.description: You may only have 2 copies of The Glass Slipper in your deck.

text.title: SEARCH THE KINGDOM
text.description: Banish this item, {E} one of your Prince characters — Search your deck for a Princess character card and reveal it to all players. Put that card into your hand and shuffle your deck.

text.title: Perfektes Paar
text.description: Dein Deck darf nur 2 Der-gläserne-Schuh-Karten enthalten.

text.title: Durchsuche das Königreich
text.description: Verbanne diesen Gegenstand, {E} einen deiner Prinzen — Durchsuche dein Deck nach einer Prinzessinnen-Charakterkarte und zeige diese allen Mitspielenden. Nimm die Karte auf deine Hand und mische danach dein Deck.

text.title: La paire parfaite
text.description: Vous ne pouvez avoir au maximum que 2 exemplaires de La Pantoufle de Verre dans votre deck.

text.title: Chercher dans tout le royaume
text.description: Bannissez cet objet, {E} l'un de vos personnages Prince — Cherchez une carte Personnage Princesse dans votre deck et révélez-la à tous les joueurs. Placez la carte révélée dans votre main et mélangez votre pioche.

text.title: Paio Perfetto
text.description: Puoi avere solo 2 copie de La Scarpetta di Cristallo nel tuo mazzo.

text.title: Cercate in Tutto il Regno
text.description: Esilia questo oggetto, {E} uno dei tuoi personaggi Principe — Cerca una carta personaggio Principessa nel tuo mazzo e rivelala a tutti i giocatori. Aggiungi quella carta alla tua mano e rimescola il tuo mazzo.

set7-084.name: Amethyst Coil
set7-084.rulesText: MAGICAL TOUCH During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: MAGICAL TOUCH
text.description: During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Magische Berührung
text.description: Jedes Mal während deines Zuges, wenn eine Karte in deinen Tintenvorrat gelegt wird, darfst du 1 Schadensmarker von einem Charakter deiner Wahl zu einem gegnerischen Charakter deiner Wahl verschieben.

text.title: Toucher magique
text.description: Durant votre tour, chaque fois qu'une carte est placée dans votre réserve d'encre, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et déplacer 1 de ses dommages sur un personnage adverse de votre choix.

text.title: Tocco Magico
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che una carta viene aggiunta al tuo calamaio, puoi spostare 1 segnalino danno da un personaggio a tua scelta a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

set7-120.name: Emerald Coil
set7-120.rulesText: SHIMMERING WINGS During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.

text.title: SHIMMERING WINGS
text.description: During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Schimmernde Flügel
text.description: Jedes Mal während deines Zuges, wenn eine Karte in deinen Tintenvorrat gelegt wird, erhält ein Charakter deiner Wahl bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Wendig>.

text.title: Ailes chatoyantes
text.description: Durant votre tour, chaque fois qu'une carte est placée dans votre réserve d'encre, choisissez un personnage qui gagne <Insaisissable> jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour.

text.title: Ali Scintillanti
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che una carta viene aggiunta al tuo calamaio, un personaggio a tua scelta ottiene <Sfuggente> fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno. (Solo altri personaggi con Sfuggente possono sfidarlo.)

set7-149.name: Ruby Coil
set7-149.rulesText: CRIMSON SPARK During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character gets +2 {S} this turn.

text.title: CRIMSON SPARK
text.description: During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, chosen character gets +2 {S} this turn.

text.title: Karminroter Funke
text.description: Jedes Mal während deines Zuges, wenn eine Karte in deinen Tintenvorrat gelegt wird, gib einem Charakter deiner Wahl in diesem Zug +2 {S}.

text.title: Étincelle pourpre
text.description: Durant votre tour, chaque fois qu'une carte est placée dans votre réserve d'encre, choisissez un personnage qui gagne +2 {S} pour le reste de ce tour.

text.title: Scintilla Scarlatta
text.description: Durante il tuo turno, ogni volta che una carta viene aggiunta al tuo calamaio, un personaggio a tua scelta riceve +2 {S} per questo turno.

set7-150.name: Unconventional Tool
set7-150.rulesText: FIXED IN NO TIME When this item is banished, you pay 2 {I} less for the next item you play this turn.

text.title: FIXED IN NO TIME
text.description: When this item is banished, you pay 2 {I} less for the next item you play this turn.

text.title: Im Handumdrehen repariert
text.description: Wenn dieser Gegenstand verbannt wird, zahlst du 2 {I} weniger für den nächsten Gegenstand, den du in diesem Zug ausspielst.

text.title: Réparé en un clin d'œil
text.description: Lorsque cet objet est banni, le prochain objet que vous jouez ce tour-ci vous coûte 2 {I} de moins.

text.title: Aggiustato in Un Momento
text.description: Quando questo oggetto viene esiliato, paga 2 {I} in meno per giocare il tuo prossimo oggetto per questo turno.

set7-151.name: Maurice's Machine
set7-151.rulesText: BREAK DOWN When this item is banished, you may return an item card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.

text.title: BREAK DOWN
text.description: When this item is banished, you may return an item card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.

text.title: Zusammenbruch
text.description: Wenn dieser Gegenstand verbannt wird, darfst du 1 Gegenstandskarte, die 2 oder weniger kostet, aus deinem Ablagestapel zurück auf deine Hand nehmen.

text.title: Tombée en panne
text.description: Lorsque cet objet est banni, vous pouvez renvoyer une carte Objet coûtant 2 ou moins de votre défausse dans votre main.

text.title: Smontare
text.description: Quando questo oggetto viene esiliato, puoi riprendere in mano una carta oggetto con costo 2 o inferiore dai tuoi scarti.

set7-152.name: Devil's Eye Diamond
set7-152.rulesText: THE PRICE OF POWER {E} — If one of your characters was damaged this turn, gain 1 lore.

text.title: THE PRICE OF POWER
text.description: {E} — If one of your characters was damaged this turn, gain 1 lore.

text.title: Der Preis der Macht
text.description: {E} — Falls einer deiner Charaktere in diesem Zug Schaden erhalten hat, sammelst du 1 Legende.

text.title: Le prix du pouvoir
text.description: {E} — Si l'un de vos personnages a subi au moins un dommage ce tour-ci, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Il Prezzo del Potere
text.description: {E} — Se uno dei tuoi personaggi ha subito danno in questo turno, ottieni 1 leggenda.

set7-179.name: Sapphire Coil

set5-031.rulesText:
SYMBOL OF NOBILITY At the start of your turn, if you have a Princess or Queen character in play, gain 1 lore.
ROYAL SEARCH {E}, 2 {I} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Princess or Queen character card, you may put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.

text.title: SYMBOL OF NOBILITY
text.description: At the start of your turn, if you have a Princess or Queen character in play, gain 1 lore.

text.title: ROYAL SEARCH
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Princess or Queen character card, you may put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.

text.title: Königliche Suche

fr.name: Cœur du détecteur de la Reine

text.title: Symbole de noblesse
text.description: Au début de votre tour, si vous avez un personnage Princesse ou Reine en jeu, gagnez 1 éclat de Lore.

text.title: Simbolo di Nobiltà
text.description: All'inizio del tuo turno, se hai in gioco un personaggio Principessa o Regina, ottieni 1 leggenda.

text.title: Ricerca Regale
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Rivela la prima carta del tuo mazzo. Se è una carta personaggio Principessa o Regina, puoi aggiungerla alla tua mano. Altrimenti, mettila in cima al tuo mazzo.

set5-032.name: Amber Chromicon
set5-032.rulesText: AMBER LIGHT {E} — Remove up to 1 damage from each of your characters.

text.title: AMBER LIGHT
text.description: {E} — Remove up to 1 damage from each of your characters.

text.title: Luce d'Ambra

set5-064.name: Retrosphere
set5-064.rulesText: EXTRACT OF AMETHYST 2 {I}, Banish this item — Return chosen character, item, or location with cost 3 or less to their player's hand.

text.description: {I}, Banish this item — Return chosen character, item, or location with cost 3 or less to their player's hand.

text.title: Extrait d'améthyste
text.description: 2 {I}, bannissez cet objet — Choisissez un personnage, un objet ou un lieu ayant un coût de 3 ou moins et renvoyez-le dans la main de son propriétaire.

text.title: Estratto di Ametista
text.description: 2 {I}, esilia questo oggetto — Fai riprendere in mano al suo giocatore un personaggio, un oggetto o un luogo a tua scelta con costo 3 o inferiore.

set5-066.rulesText: AMETHYST LIGHT {E} — Each player may draw a card.

text.title: AMETHYST LIGHT
text.description: {E} — Each player may draw a card.

text.title: Luce d'Ametista
text.description: {E} — Ogni giocatore può pescare una carta.

set5-098.name: Prince John's Mirror
set5-098.rulesText:
YOU LOOK REGAL If you have a character named Prince John in play, you pay 1 {I} less to play this item.
A FEELING OF POWER At the end of each opponent's turn, if they have more than 3 cards in their hand, they discard until they have 3 cards in their hand.

text.title: YOU LOOK REGAL
text.description: If you have a character named Prince John in play, you pay 1 {I} less to play this item.

text.title: A FEELING OF POWER
text.description: At the end of each opponent's turn, if they have more than 3 cards in their hand, they discard until they have 3 cards in their hand.

text.title: Jeder Zoll ein König
text.description: Wenn du einen Prinz-John-Charakter im Spiel hast, zahlst du 1 {I} weniger, um diesen Gegenstand auszuspielen.

text.title: Das Gefühl von Macht
text.description: Am Ende des Zuges jeder gegnerischen Person und falls diese mehr als 3 Karten auf der Hand hat, muss diese Person so lange Karten von der Hand abwerfen, bis sie nur noch 3 Karten auf der Hand hat.

text.title: Vous êtes une royale image
text.description: Jouer cet objet vous coûte 1 {I} de moins si vous avez un personnage Prince Jean en jeu.

text.title: Un sentiment de puissance
text.description: À la fin du tour de chaque adversaire, s'il a plus de 3 cartes en main, il défausse des cartes jusqu'à en avoir 3 en main.

text.title: Vi Dà un Aspetto Regale
text.description: Se hai in gioco un personaggio chiamato Principe Giovanni, paga 1 {I} in meno per giocare questo oggetto.

text.title: Il Senso del Potere
text.description: Alla fine del turno di ogni avversario, se questo ha più di 3 carte in mano, deve scartare carte finché non ne ha 3 in mano.

set5-099.name: Obscurosphere
set5-099.rulesText: EXTRACT OF EMERALD 2 {I}, Banish this item — Your characters gain Ward until the start of your next turn.

text.title: EXTRACT OF EMERALD 2
text.description: {I}, Banish this item — Your characters gain Ward until the start of your next turn.

text.title: Extrakt aus Smaragd
text.description: 2 {I}, Verbanne diesen Gegenstand — Deine Charaktere erhalten bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges <Behütet>. (Gegnerische Mitspielende können die Charaktere nicht auswählen, außer um sie herauszufordern.)

text.title: Extrait d'émeraude
text.description: 2 {I}, bannissez cet objet — Vos personnages gagnent <Hors d'atteinte> jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour. (Les adversaires ne peuvent pas choisir ces personnages, hormis pour un défi.)

text.title: Estratto di Smeraldo
text.description: 2 {I}, esilia questo oggetto — I tuoi personaggi ottengono <Protetto> fino all'inizio del tuo prossimo turno. (Gli avversari non possono sceglierli se non per sfidarli.)

set5-100.name: Emerald Chromicon
set5-100.rulesText: EMERALD LIGHT During opponents' turns, whenever one of your characters is banished, you may return chosen character to their player's hand.

text.title: EMERALD LIGHT
text.description: During opponents' turns, whenever one of your characters is banished, you may return chosen character to their player's hand.

text.title: Smaragdfarbenes Licht
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn einer deiner Charaktere im Zug einer gegnerischen Person verbannt wird, darfst du einen Charakter deiner Wahl zurück auf die zugehörige Hand schicken.

text.title: Lueur d'émeraude
text.description: Durant le tour de vos adversaires, chaque fois que l'un de vos personnages est banni, vous pouvez choisir un personnage et le renvoyer dans la main de son propriétaire.

text.title: Luce di Smeraldo
text.description: Durante il turno degli avversari, ogni volta che uno dei tuoi personaggi viene esiliato, puoi far riprendere in mano al suo giocatore un personaggio a tua scelta.

set5-132.name: Potion of Might
set5-132.rulesText: VILE CONCOCTION 1 {I}, Banish this item — Chosen character gets +3 {S} this turn. If a Villain character is chosen, they get +4 {S} instead.

text.title: VILE CONCOCTION 1
text.description: {I}, Banish this item — Chosen character gets +3 {S} this turn. If a Villain character is chosen, they get +4 {S} instead.

text.title: Abscheuliches Gebräu
text.description: 1 {I}, Verbanne diesen Gegenstand — Gib einem Charakter deiner Wahl in diesem Zug +3 {S}. Wählst du einen Schurken, dann gib dem Charakter stattdessen +4 {S}.

text.title: Décoction abjecte
text.description: 1 {I}, bannissez cet objet — Choisissez un personnage qui gagne +3 {S} pour le reste de ce tour. Si ce personnage est un Méchant, il gagne +4 {S} à la place.

text.title: Intruglio Disgustoso
text.description: 1 {I}, esilia questo oggetto — Un personaggio a tua scelta riceve +3 {S} per questo turno. Se quel personaggio è un Cattivo, riceve invece +4 {S}.

set5-133.name: The Sword Released
set5-133.rulesText: POWER APPOINTED At the start of your turn, if you have a character in play with more {S} than each opposing character in play, each opponent loses 1 lore and you gain lore equal to the lore lost.

text.title: POWER APPOINTED
text.description: At the start of your turn, if you have a character in play with more {S} than each opposing character in play, each opponent loses 1 lore and you gain lore equal to the lore lost.

text.title: Erteilte Macht
text.description: Zu Beginn deines Zuges, wenn du einen Charakter mit einer höheren {S} als die {S} aller gegnerischen Charaktere im Spiel hast, verlieren alle gegnerischen Mitspielenden je 1 Legende und du sammlest, für jede so verlorene Legende, je 1 Legende.

text.title: La puissance est conférée
text.description: Au début de votre tour, si vous avez un personnage en jeu avec une {S} plus élevée que chaque personnage adverse, chaque adversaire perd 1 éclat de Lore. Vous gagnez autant d'éclats de Lore que vos adversaires en ont perdu.

text.title: Designato dal Potere
text.description: All'inizio del tuo turno, se hai in gioco un personaggio con più {S} di ogni personaggio avversario in gioco, ogni avversario perde 1 leggenda e tu ottieni leggenda pari alla leggenda persa.

text.title: Luce di Rubino

text.title: Congratulazioni, Soldato

set5-166.rulesText: FIND WHAT'S HIDDEN {E}, 2 {I} — Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Schaue dir die obersten 3 Karten deines Decks an. Du darfst 1 Gegenstandskarte daraus aufdecken und auf deine Hand nehmen. Lege die restlichen Karten in beliebiger Reihenfolge unter dein Deck.

text.title: Révéler l'invisible
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Regardez les 3 cartes du dessus de votre pioche. Vous pouvez révéler une carte Objet parmi elles et la prendre en main. Remettez les autres cartes sous votre pioche, dans l'ordre de votre choix.

text.title: Trovare Ciò Che È Nascosto
text.description: {E}, 2 {I} — Guarda le prime 3 carte del tuo mazzo. Puoi rivelare una carta oggetto e aggiungerla alla tua mano. Metti il resto in fondo al tuo mazzo in qualsiasi ordine.

set5-167.name: Merlin's Carpetbag
set5-167.rulesText: HOCKETY POCKETY {E}, 1 {I} — Return an item card from your discard to your hand.

text.title: Hockety Pockety

text.description: Banish this item — If you have 3 or more characters in play, gain 2 lore and remove up to 2 damage from chosen location.

text.description: Verbanne diesen Gegenstand — Wenn du mindestens 3 Charaktere im Spiel hast, sammle 2 Legenden und entferne bis zu 2 Schaden von einem Ort deiner Wahl.

text.title: Le Don d'Abuela
text.description: Bannissez cet objet — Si vous avez 3 personnages ou plus en jeu, gagnez 2 éclats de Lore et choisissez un lieu et retirez-lui jusqu'à 2 jetons Dommage.

text.description: Esilia questo oggetto — Se hai in gioco 3 o più personaggi, ottieni 2 leggenda e rimuovi fino a 2 danni da un luogo a tua scelta.

set4-032.name: Record Player
set4-032.rulesText:
LOOK AT THIS! Whenever you play a song, chosen character gets -2 {S} until the start of your next turn.
HIT PARADE Your characters named Stitch count as having +1 cost to sing songs.

text.title: LOOK AT THIS!
text.description: Whenever you play a song, chosen character gets -2 {S} until the start of your next turn.

text.title: HIT PARADE
text.description: Your characters named Stitch count as having +1 cost to sing songs.

text.title: Guck mal hier!
text.description: Jedes Mal, wenn du ein Lied ausspielst, erhält ein Charakter deiner Wahl bis zu Beginn deines nächsten Zuges -2 {S}.

text.title: Hitparade
text.description: Die Kosten deiner Stitch-Charaktere gelten als +1 für das Singen von Liedern.

text.title: Regarde!

text.title: Hit Parade

set4-064.name: Mystical Rose
set4-064.rulesText: DISPEL THE ENTANGLEMENT Banish this item — Chosen character named Beast gets +2 {L} this turn. If you have a character named Belle in play, move up to 3 damage counters from chosen character to chosen opposing character.

text.title: Dissiper l'envoutement
text.description: Bannissez cet objet — Choisissez un personnage La Bête qui gagne +2 {L} pour le reste de ce tour. Si vous avez un personnage Belle en jeu, choisissez un personnage et déplacez jusqu'à 3 de ses jetons Dommage sur un personnage adverse de votre choix.

text.title: Sciogliere il Groviglio
text.description: Esilia questo oggetto — Un personaggio a tua scelta chiamato La Bestia riceve +2 {L} per questo turno. Se hai in gioco un personaggio chiamato Belle, sposta fino a 3 segnalini danno da un personaggio a tua scelta a un personaggio avversario a tua scelta.

• Choisissez un personnage Méchant et redressez-le. Il ne peut pas être envoyé à l'aventure pour le reste de ce tour.
Cammina!
